Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
 
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
 
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram. 

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Senior Product Manager who will oversee product development from conception to launch across multiple products or segments and discover, develop, and cultivate new products and ongoing product enhancements that support Geotab’s business models and continued growth. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Senior Product Manager your key area of responsibility will be understanding the infrastructure needed to support the growth of revenue streams, owning the comprehensive product roadmap, and driving portfolio-level prioritization aligned with overall business strategy. You will need to work closely with UX designers, developers, data scientists, technical project managers, customers, and senior leadership. To be successful in this role you will be a self-starter, resourceful, empathetic listener, and a strong team player with well-defined diplomacy, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, an entrepreneurial mindset, strategic thinking, and experience leveraging user engagement metrics and product KPIs to drive data-informed decision-making.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description:
About Us 
 Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.
 Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.
 We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.
 Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.
 About the Position 
 We're looking for a proactive and highly organized Technical Project Manager to lead customer implementations across Constructor's product suite. You will lead onboardings for new customers as well as implementations of additional products for existing customers, owning each engagement from kickoff through activation. You will own the plan, the timeline, and the outcome, and you drive the people delivering it through a matrixed reporting structure. As we build toward an automation-first operating model, you will help standardize how implementations are run and increasingly act as a portfolio strategist, managing exceptions while repeatable, AI-assisted processes carry the routine work.
 You will: 
 • Lead multiple implementations end to end, both new-customer onboardings and additional-product rollouts for existing customers, from kickoff through integration, testing, and activation.
 • Take accountability for the outcome of every implementation, coordinating Constructor resources, customer resources, and partners, against a single shared plan.
 • Run kickoffs, set milestones, track dependencies, and maintain a clear, shared view of status for internal stakeholders and the customer.
 • Serve as the customer's primary point of contact through activation, setting expectations and communicating progress, risks, and changes in scope.
 • Identify risks and blockers early, escalate effectively, and keep implementations moving toward on-time, predictable delivery.
 • Ensure clean handoffs into implementation from Sales and out of implementation to Customer Success and Support.
 • Maintain implementation plans and reporting in our systems of record so schedule, duration, and status roll up cleanly across your portfolio.
 • Help build the repeatable processes, templates, and standards that let the function scale, and partner on the automation-first model as it matures.
 Role Responsibilities: Technical Project Management 
 • Own the Outcome: Be accountable for the success of each implementation from kickoff to activation, whether the work is delivered by Constructor, the customer, or a partner, standing behind on-time, predictable go-live for both new customers and existing-customer product rollouts.
 • Drive Every Contributor: Coordinate Constructor technical resources, customer resources, and partners against one plan, holding each accountable to their commitments through influence rather than authority.
 • Lead the Customer Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact through activation, running a clear communication rhythm and building customer confidence from kickoff to handoff.
 • Manage Handoffs & Risk: Ensure accurate handoffs from Sales into implementation and from implementation into Customer Success and Support, surfacing risk early and keeping delivery on track wherever the risk sits.
 • Build Scalable Process: Standardize how implementations are run at Constructor, maintain accurate tracking and reporting, and help advance the automation-first operating model as the function grows.
 Requirements 
 You Have 
 • At least 3 years of technical project management or onboarding project management experience, ideally in a SaaS environment.
 • A track record of owning delivery outcomes end to end and holding cross-functional contributors accountable through influence rather than direct authority.
 • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to run multiple implementations in parallel without losing the thread.
 • Customer-facing confidence: you can lead a kickoff, manage expectations, and kee

 CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen. Unsere Software unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, dass Alleinarbeitende im Notfall schnell Hilfe erhalten. CALIMA wird von über tausend Unternehmen genutzt und schützt täglich tausende Mitarbeitende.
 Wir sind ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, produktnah und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dabei suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und unsere Prozesse aktiv verbessern.
 Deine Rolle
 Als Product Owner wirst du unsere erste fest angestellte Person im Produktmanagement und übernimmst die operative Produktverantwortung für unsere Entwicklungsteams: Cloud, Mobile Apps für iOS und Android sowie Platform.
 Aktuell liegen Backlog, Tickets und Planung direkt beim Head of Tech. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Teams verlässlich an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten: ein gut sortiertes Backlog, klar definierte Tickets, ein funktionierendes Refinement und realistisch abgestimmte Deadlines. Du wirst das Bindeglied zwischen dem Head of Tech, den kleinen, remote arbeitenden Entwicklungsteams, QA, Sales und Customer Success.
 Wir entwickeln ein sicherheitsrelevantes Produkt. Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität stehen bei uns vor Feature-Menge.
 Perspektivisch kannst du deine Rolle in Richtung strategisches Product Management weiterentwickeln und Themen wie Roadmap, Markt und Produktstrategie aktiv mitgestalten.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Backlog und Tickets
 Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Customer Success, Sales und Support in Epics und Tickets und klärst offene Fragen.

 Du pflegst ein priorisiertes Backlog je Team und stellst sicher, dass nur klar definierte Tickets in die Entwicklung gehen.

 Du formulierst Tickets mit Ziel, Akzeptanzkriterien und Abgrenzung so, dass Entwicklung und QA ohne Rückfragen starten können.

 Konzeption
 Du leitest aus Kundenfeedback und Anfragen von Sales und Customer Success ab, welches Problem dahintersteht und welche Verbesserung den größten Nutzen bringt.

 Du arbeitest Features konzeptionell aus, mit Zielbild, Abläufen und Edge Cases, bevor daraus Tickets werden.

 Du bewertest Lösungsvarianten gemeinsam mit den Entwickler:innen nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiko.

 Du sprichst gemeinsam mit Customer Success und Sales mit Kund:innen und prüfst Konzepte mit ihnen, bevor wir sie umsetzen.

 Planung und Steuerung
 Du bereitest die Quartalsplanung mit dem Head of Tech vor und findest die Balance zwischen Kapazitäten und Deadlines.

 Du moderierst Refinements, übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung die Moderation unserer Team-Weeklies, behältst Action Items im Blick und entwickelst die Produktkoordination und die zugehörigen Abläufe weiter.

 Du hältst die Boards aktuell, erkennst Blocker früh und eskalierst sie an die richtige Person.

 Schnittstellen
 Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Sales, CS und QA bei Fragen zu Status und Priorität.

 Du hältst Sales und Customer Success proaktiv auf dem Laufenden, wo ein Release steht und was sich verschiebt.

 Du steuerst, was in Benutzerhandbuch und Kundendokumentation landet.

 Du koordinierst unsere externen App-Entwickler:innen auf Ticketebene.

 Du lieferst die Inhalte für Release Notes und Team Testing.

 Deine ersten Monate
 In den ersten Wochen lernst du Team, Produkt und Kunden kennen und übernimmst Backlog und Tickets der Teams Schritt für Schritt.

 Danach moderierst du Refinements und Weeklies und baust mit uns einen Planungsrhythmus auf, der Fortschritt messbar macht.

 Nach etwa drei Monaten läuft die operative Produktarbeit über dich, und Sales und Customer Success wissen jederzeit, wo ein Release steht.

 Das bringst du mit
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager:in oder technische:r Projektmanager:in in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise in einem B2B-SaaS- oder Startup-Umfeld.

 Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Methoden sowie Erfahrung in Backlog-Management, Priorisierung, Sprint- und Releaseplanung und der Moderation agiler Meetings.

 Du schreibst Tickets, die Entwickler:innen gerne umsetzen: klar, vollständig, mit sauberen Akzeptanzkriterien.

 Genug technisches Verständnis, um Aufwände und Lösungsvorschläge zu hinterfragen, gerne mit Erfahrung in Web- und Mobile-Produkten.

 Erfahrung mit Ticketingsystemen wie GitHub Projects, Jira oder vergleichbaren Tools.

 Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise in einem Remote-Team und klare Kommunikation zwischen Tech und Business.

 Qualitätsanspruch: Du nimmst lieber früh Scope raus, als kurzfristig ein Release verschieben zu müssen.

 Aktive Nutzung von AI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, zum Beispiel für Ticket-Entwürfe, Analysen und Dokumentation.

jobs.description:
Principal Product Manager (AI Product) - Join Our Innovative Team at thinkcell Software 

Our Story 

At thinkcell, we create powerful software solutions that help professionals be more efficient and productive. Founded in 2002 and based in Berlin, our tools integrate seamlessly with Microsoft Office to help users create presentations, charts, and diagrams with ease. Our dynamic, international team values creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence. 

What You Will Do  

You'll co-own our AI product end-to-end, from discovery to business outcome. You'll set directions to product managers who each own parts of the product, while staying close to customers and internal stakeholders. With designers and engineers, you'll make sure we build the right things and build them well. This is a pivotal role to help execute an ambitious vision. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Co-own the product 

  • Co-own our AI product end-to-end, from market research and discovery through to UAT and release together with product design and engineering
  • Translate user needs into relevant business outcomes, not just features and products
  • Contribute to product vision, strategy and roadmap in close partnership with leadership 

Teaming 

  • Foster an empowered team across product, design and engineering to deliver great outcomes
  • Set direction for and coach other product managers who own parts of the product

jobs.title: Bid & Project Manager – EU & NATO (H/F)
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares
 
Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.
 Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
 Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.
 Role & Mission 
 NATO agencies & EU programs are investing in counter-drone capability now, and Alta Ares answers a fast-growing flow of their tenders and calls for proposals. As Bid & Project Manager in our EU, NATO & Eastern Flank team, you turn each opportunity into a compliant offer, then into a project delivered on time. Your sales director owns the customer relationship and the commercial strategy; you own the offer and its delivery.
 This is not a one-programme job. You will run several bids and projects at once: a NATO bid, an EU grant proposal, and an RFI can land in the same week, and none of them can slip.
 This is a demanding, high-ownership role. Deadlines do not move, the stakes are real, and the team will rely on you to hold the line. We are looking for someone who wants that responsibility.
 
 Bid Management - from first read to submission 
 Screen and qualify opportunities with your sales director; prepare bid/no-bid decisions with risks, resources, and price on the table

 Break each tender down (NATO IFB or RFQ, EU call, RFP for a Nation through EU-NATO platforms such as NSPA or SAFE joint procurement) into a compliance matrix, a bid plan and clear owners

 Write and assemble the management, technical and compliance volumes with Engineering, Product, Finance and Legal

 Organise the review gates and prepare the final price review with Finance; submit complete, compliant and on time, every time

 Run the clarification rounds and support your sales director in negotiations through to contract signature

 
 NATO & EU Procurement - the rules of the game 
 Master NSPA and NCIA procedures: Source File registration, declarations of eligibility, notifications of intent, IFBs and RFQs, basic ordering agreements and framework contracts

 Run EU grant proposals (European Defence Fund, EDIP): Funding & Tenders portal, consortium building, Part A and Part B, lump-sum budgets

 Track national procurement rules and partners on the Eastern Flank through EU-NATO (Poland, Romania, the Baltic States…), e.g. via NSPA or SAFE joint procurement

 Build and maintain the bid library: company documents, CVs, past performance, standard answers, templates

 
 Project Delivery - from award to acceptance 
 Turn each award into a project: kick-off, plan, milestones, risks, budget and change control

 Coordinate engineering, production, demo and logistics teams, and partners, to deliver what we promised when we promised it

 Own customer reporting, deliverables and acceptance (FAT/SAT), with the documentation trail for invoicing and audits

 Run several projects in parallel, each at a different stage

 
 Process & Reporting 
 Set the bid and project rhythm for the team: calendar, gates, templates, dashboards

 Review the status of every live bid and project weekly with your sales director: deadlines, compliance, risks, resources needed

 Run lessons learned after every bid, won or lost

 
 Candidate Profile 
 5+ years in bid, proposal or project management in defence, aerospace or security

 Proven record of compliant, on-time submissions to NATO agencies, EU programmes or European ministries of defence, several of them in parallel

 At least one defence contract delivered from award to acceptance

 Scale-up or lean-team experience is a significant advantage; prime experience is welcome if you want more breadth and speed

 Skills & Qualities 
 Rigorous and precise compliance is binary; in defence, the margin for error is zero

 Built for parallel work you run several bids and projects at once, prioritise hard and never drop the ball

 Committed you own the outcome, not just your part of it; submission peaks are part of the job and you plan for them

 Calm under pressure fixed deadlines, late amendments and competing requests do not throw you

 A clear writer structured, scoreable English; you turn engineering input into compliant answers

 A leader without authority you get engineers, Finance, Legal and partners to deliver on time

 Technically curious you understand how sensors, effectors, C2 and AI fit together, or you learn it fast

 Discreet and trustworthy you handle sensitive commercial and defence information as a matter of course

 Mission-driven you care about European security, not just the job title

 Nice to Have 
 APMP, Shipley, PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA certification

 Experience on a European Defence Fund or EDIP consor

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Business Banking
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Business Banking 
 Build with us 
 Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.
 Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.
 We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs, with 900+ Mollies across 12+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you’re solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you’ll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.
 If you’re ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.
 
 Your impact 
 As Senior Product Manager, you'll own a significant part of our Business Banking product, one of the newest and most ambitious areas we're building at Mollie.
 This is a build from scratch opportunity. Mollie's position here is rare: we're a payment service provider with a large, established customer base that is now building a full banking proposition on top of it. That means you get the ambition and pace of building something new, combined with the resources, customers, and best practices of a scaled business. You'll work alongside experienced, passionate product leaders who've done this before.
 You'll lead a cross-functional team across design, product, and data analytics. There are no direct reports in this role, but you'll own the team's day to day performance and make sure things ship on time.
 
 What you'll ship 
 Net-new propositions, not incremental iteration. You're building experiences that don't exist yet.

 Customer-facing product and APIs across the Mollie app (web and native mobile) for business banking customers.

 A banking proposition layered on Mollie's existing payments infrastructure, reaching customers who are already active and engaged.
 

 What you'll bring 
 Experience leading a cross-functional product team in an everyday, hands-on capacity

 Comfort with the full product lifecycle, including early-stage building and scaling

 Ability to operate in a high-ambition, high-resource environment alongside experienced and passionate product leaders from across the industry
 

 Grow your way 
 At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.
 In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to build a meaningful distribution channel from the ground up. As we expand across Europe, you will grow alongside the product area you own. You’ll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way.
 
 Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy 
 If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe.
 Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.
 
 AI at Mollie 
 We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

Product Manager - Agent Experience 

Location: Paris, France preferred, open to London applicants (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Salary: €46,000 – €55,000 / £47,000 – £59,000

Reporting To: Lead Product Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end strategy for Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) within the European market—grounded in global product goals but sharpened by local client needs and agent behaviors. Driving core operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, AI adoption, onboarding)ensuring capabilities improve agent/customer outcomes.
  • Drive Journey Design & UX Consistency: Act as guardian of agent UX across KAE to ensure coherence across the experience. Partnering with UX and domain teams to apply shared patterns consistently, reduce agent cognitive load, and maintain alignment and compliance with the design system as new automation and assistive/AI capabilities are introduced.
  • Lead Integrations & Client Onboarding: Drive technical and product integrations with third-party platforms and oversee spinning up new KAE instances end-to-end for incoming clients from discovery through go-live.
  • Ensure Accessibility & Compliance: Champion EU accessibility regulations by design, translating regulatory and market-specific needs into actionable engineering requirements.
  • Engage Clients & Drive Value: Serve as the trusted expert for clients on agent experience, advocating for platform-first configuration over bespoke builds

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

  • Bilingual Capability: Full professional bilingual fluency (written and spoken) in both English and French.

What will set you apart 

  • Experience leveraging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, or LLM integrations within product workflows to enhance platform intelligence and automation directly into customer service desktop envir

 Our mission

 Your impact 
 Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them.
 You are the product owner for our largest registry partner and decide what gets built within a fixed capacity. You also make sure that what we build strengthens the wider LOGEX platform wherever possible.
 
 What you'll own 
 Applications: user-facing applications for manual data entry, dashboarding and exports – owning the roadmap, priorities and release quality.

 Pipelines and business logic: registry processing (merge, load, curation), data exports, scientific data requests, data linkage and registry development sets.

 One backlog, two types of developers: you lead the product work of a team that combines data engineers with back-end and front-end developers. You translate user and partner’s needs into work for both, and you see early where a front-end change depends on a pipeline change.

 Prioritisation within fixed capacity: you align with one counterpart at our largest registry partner on what gets built and when, with transparent trade-offs, realistic yearly planning and a clear path to extra capacity when it is funded.

 Reusable by design: you turn partner-specific needs into shared LOGEX components wherever possible, in close collaboration with other Product Owners and Product Managers.

 Regulatory and standards readiness: you make sure the products keep meeting healthcare regulation and move along with open data standards, e.g. FHIR.

 Run and improve: you balance new development with maintenance and technical debt, and you help to reduce key-person risk in a small team.

 Customer-facing: you work closely with the Customer Office on scope, project proposals and delivery expectations, and you represent the products in partner and user sessions.

 At least 5 years of experience as product owner or product manager

 Experience working with a team of mixed engineering profiles

Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.


Your Responsibilities

  • Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively. 

Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers' expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn't exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we're rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades. 

That means there are interesting product problems to solve - not just features to deliver. 

You'll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions. 

You'll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it. 

 

How we work 

We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty. 

We don't expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions. 

You'll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them. 

You'll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something.

 Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

jobs.title: Chef.fe de Projet Hôpitaux / Project Manager Hospital
jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.
 Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.
 Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.
 
 
 ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations 
 L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.
 En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.
 
 
 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous 
 Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

 Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement.

 Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions.

 Coordonner Business Development, Customer Operations, Ops Manager et R&D.

 Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

 Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés.

 Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

 
 
 ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons 
 Must-have
 Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

 Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

 Des bases en interopérabilité, en flux de données et en FHIR.

 La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire.

 Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes.

 Nice-to-have
 Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

 Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

 L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

 Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

 Soft skills
 Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.
 
 
 Nos valeurs
 Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.
 Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes.
 Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé.
 
 
 👥 Process de recrutement 
 Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition - 30 min. Un premier échange pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta motivation pour le poste.

 Entretien avec Loïc, Hiring Manager - 45 min. Une première rencontre avec ton potentiel futur manager qui approfondira ton expérience de gestion de projet et de déploiement, ta compréhension des environnements de santé et ta connaissance fonctionnelle des produits déployés.

 Étude de cas avec Loïc et un membre de l’équipe Customer Ops - 60 à 90 min. Quelques jours avant l’échange, nous t’enverrons une étude de cas à préparer. jobs.title: Product Owner - Mobile Integrations (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually
 Creating solutions that run on 13% of the world’s smartphones 
 The Mobile Integrations team builds the core technology that turns advertising from an interruption into a rewarded experience for 770 million users. We own the robust, lightweight, integration layer between our ad engine and the global mobile ecosystem, ensuring our technology operates with minimal overhead while reaching a massive portion of the smartphone market.
 On the client side, our technology performs smoothly across 20 million daily SDK initializations. We build native Swift and Kotlin SDKs optimized for ms initialization and minimal binary overhead, with Unity, Flutter, and React Native wrappers that provide a unified API across the entire mobile ecosystem. Behind the scenes, a high-throughput Go and DynamoDB architecture handles the real-time state synchronization of millions of concurrent sessions. When your code runs on nearly one out of every seven smartphones on Earth, every millisecond of execution and every byte of memory counts.
 What you Will Do: 
 Own and prioritize the Mobile SDK product backlog, balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical requirements, and engineering capacity.

 Translate product and developer needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable priorities for the engineering team.

 Drive feature delivery from discovery and planning through development, testing, release, and post-launch evaluation.

 Work closely with Android, iOS, Backend, QA, and other stakeholders to manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and ensure smooth delivery.

 Gather and analyze feedback from customers, developers, and internal teams to identify integration pain points and opportunities to improve the SDK and developer experience.

 Support SDK releases and rollouts, including release planning, documentation, adoption tracking, and communication with relevant stakeholders.

 Use product data, SDK telemetry, and feedback to measure outcomes, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the Mobile SDK platform.

 Who You Are: 
 You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Product Owner in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. (Bonus points if you have a background in ad-tech or Mobile/SDKs) 

 You aren't expected to write code, but you are right at home discussing SDK architecture. You grasp the fundamentals and differences between iOS and Android, empowering you to have meaningful debates with the development team and properly weigh technical debt against business value.

As a Senior Product Manager (m/w/d), you will own eCommerce storefront initiatives end to end, from concept and discovery through launch and optimization, with a global scope across PERGOLUX markets. You will define product solutions, scope, and success metrics for content-rich, UX-heavy customer journeys, and you will drive measurable improvements in storefront performance such as add-to-cart and checkout conversion. Working closely with UX, development, analytics, performance marketing, and country teams, you will structure complex product information into clear, attractive pages that reflect a premium brand experience.
 PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, we have grown consistently across Europe and beyond, building a collaborative international team along the way.
 What You'll Do 
 • Own eCommerce product initiatives from concept to launch and optimization, defining scope, risks, requirements, and success metrics.
 • Conduct product discovery through user research, competitor analysis, usability testing, and synthesizing customer feedback into product decisions.
 • Create page concepts, wireframes, prototypes, copy drafts, and visual briefs, and write clear specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
 • Plan delivery with development, managing priorities, dependencies, QA, releases, rollout logic, toggles, and rollback plans.
 • Monitor launches and use analytics, A/B testing, and experimentation to drive rapid fixes and follow-up improvements to storefront performance.
 What You'll Bring 
 • 5+ years in product management for eCommerce products, with strong experience in UX-heavy, content-rich customer journeys.
 • Proven ability to structure complex product information into clear, simple, and attractive pages, backed by customer research and insight-driven decisions.
 • Strong visual taste and an understanding of what makes a premium digital brand experience, plus the ability to create concepts, wireframes, and copy drafts independently.
 • Solid command of CRO, analytics, A/B testing, and storefront performance optimization, and a track record of aligning UX, developers, analytics, and marketing.
 • Nice to have: experience with Shopify or other storefront platforms, high-ticket or considered-purchase eCommerce, premium/lifestyle brands, and building repeatable product processes or templates.

 💼 Compensation — Competitive salary that reflects your expertise and rewards results · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, with no endless unpaid crunch

jobs.description:
About Welo Global 

 Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications.  The Role 

 
 We are seeking an experienced English into German (Switzerland) Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. 

 
 You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

 What You Will Do 

 -Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
 -Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
 -Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
 -Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
 -Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time. 

 What You Will Own 

 -The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking 
 

 
 
 Requirements 

 - Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles 
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution 
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping 
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI) 
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting 
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements 
- Language: Native-level German (Switzerland) and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior e xperience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – JetBrains Air (Agentic Development in IDEs)
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable navigating complex software systems, working with coding agents, and defining what makes developer tools actually useful? Do you want to shape how developers and AI work together inside IDEs?

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Agentic development is changing how software gets built. Developers no longer just chat with AI – they delegate tasks, run parallel agent sessions, and steer autonomous changes. As agents take on more work, reviewing and owning the output is becoming the hardest part of the process. 

JetBrains Air is our open system for agentic development. It brings tools like Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agent, Gemini, and Junie directly into JetBrains IDEs, providing an agentic-first user experience.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead key areas of Air. You’ll take ownership of high-impact workflows, work closely with cross-functional teams (including software engineers, designers, ML researchers, analysts, DevRel, and product marketing), and turn technical complexity into clear product direction.

Day to day, you will:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of key parts of Air in JetBrains IDEs, driving work from problem framing and discovery to delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Define and refine core agentic workflows, including task delegation, session monitoring, steering, and code review.
  • Model complex user flows, system states, permissions, and integration schemes to guide engineering and design decisions.
  • Maintain a transparent roadmap that balances quick improvements with long-term strategic investments.
  • Define telemetry, design experiments, analyze product data, and make evidence-based roadmap decisions.
  • Study how developers interact with leading AI agents and tools to inform product priorities.
  • Engage with the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) ecosystem and collaborate with partners building on it.
  • Partner with enterprise sales and support teams to address governance, privacy, and control requirements.

What you’ll bring

  • A systems-thinking mindset that easily breaks down complex architectures, workflows, and dependencies.
  • A data-driven approach to product decisions, including hands-on experience querying and analyzing telemetry.
  • Active personal experience using coding agents and clear perspectives on where current AI tools succeed and fail.
  • Strong product intuition for complex technical user experiences and developer workflows.
  • Clear, concise, and collaborative communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply and build alignment across diverse groups of stakeholders.
  • Comfort navigating fast-changing technical landscapes with high ambiguity.

What you’ll need

  • Proven experience shipping end-user products as a product manager or in a similar role.
  • Strong technical grounding in software development workflows, including IDEs, git, code review, CI/CD, and package management.
  • A hands-on technical background sufficient to collaborate closely with software and ML engineers.
  • An understanding of core AI and agent concepts, including tool use, protocols (MCP/ACP), context retrieval, evaluations, and latency/cost trade-offs.
  • The ability to write SQL or Python to analyze product metrics and experiment results independently.
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

What success looks like

In your first 6 to 12 months, success in this role means:

  • Driving measurable growth in active Air users and improving weekly/monthly retention (D7/D30).
  • Increasing agent session completion rates and the proportion of agent-generated changes accepted by developers.
  • Establishing clear, telemetry-backed decisions across your product roadmap areas.
  • Delivering validated product hypotheses consistently each quarter.
  • Contributing directly to JetBrains AI revenue growth and overall IDE value.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Free meals and sna

jobs.title: Head of Product Management & Transformation (Risk, Finance & Compliance)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and visionary professional to join as Head of Product Management (Risk, Finance & Compliance) , taking strategic responsibility for a newly established Product Management division within a leading Swiss banking environment.
 In this key leadership position, you will be responsible for the strategic direction, development and management of the product portfolio across Risk, Finance and Compliance . You will act as a central interface between business functions, IT and Senior Management, ensuring that business requirements are translated into effective, sustainable and customer-oriented solutions.
 The position combines strategic product management, leadership, digital transformation and stakeholder management , with a clear focus on measurable business value and the continuous development of end-to-end processes across the organisation.
 
Workload: 80–100%

 Your Responsibilities 
 Take end-to-end responsibility for the Product Management division covering Risk, Finance & Compliance

 Define and implement the strategic vision, product portfolio and roadmap for the relevant business areas

 Develop customer-oriented solutions aligned with the needs of Business Owners and specialist departments

 Manage the implementation and continuous development of products within the Agile Release Train

 Lead and develop the Product Management team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and customer focus

 Act as the central interface between Risk, Finance, Compliance, IT, Business Owners and other relevant stakeholders

 Ensure that business requirements are translated into effective and sustainable IT solutions

 Further develop and digitalise end-to-end business processes across applications, processes and channels

 Ensure a measurable contribution of the product division to the organisation's strategic objectives, particularly in the areas of growth, efficiency and customer satisfaction

 Lead and support transformation initiatives across Risk, Finance and Compliance

 Manage complex stakeholder environments and align strategic priorities with implementation and IT delivery

 Ensure that processes and solutions comply with regulatory and compliance requirements

 Work closely with Senior Management and relevant internal and external stakeholders

 Monitor performance, priorities and value contribution across the product portfolio

 Identify opportunities for innovation, process optimisation and further development of the product landscape

 
 Your Profile 
 Several years of professional experience in a leadership position within the financial services or banking industry

 Strong understanding of Risk, Finance and Compliance processes within a banking environment

 Proven experience in product management, product strategy and/or business transformation

 Excellent understanding of end-to-end processes and value creation within the financial services sector

 Experience leading and developing teams and managing complex organisational structures

 Proven track record in transformation projects, as well as experience with agile methodologies and modern organisational structures

 Strong understanding of IT and technological interdependencies, with the ability to bridge the gap between business and IT

 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly when working with Senior Management

 Entrepreneurial mindset combined with a pragmatic, decisive and results-oriented approach

 Ability to set clear priorities and successfully drive strategic initiatives through to implementation

 Strong analytical and conceptual skills combined with a hands-on execution mindset

 University degree in Business Administration, Banking, Business Information Systems or a comparable field

 Very good written and spoken German and English

 
 What We Offer 
 A strategic leadership position with comprehensive responsibility for an entire Product Management division

 The opportunity to actively shape a newly established Product Management organisation covering Risk, Finance & Compliance

 Significant influence on the bank's digital transformation and future product landscape

 A high degree of autonomy and entrepreneurial responsibility

 Close collaboration with Senior Management, business functions and IT

 A modern, agile and customer-oriented working environment

 A flexible hybrid working model with home-office options

 Attractive opportunities for professional development and career progression into leadership roles

 A stable and future-oriented environment within an established Swiss financial institution

jobs.title: Product Lead 100%
jobs.description:
Unsere Mission 
 Photovoltaik wirtschaftlich, einfach und sorglos machen. Wir bringen die Energiewende ins Gebäude – mit intelligenten Lösungen für Eigenverbrauch & Elektromobilität, die sich für alle lohnen: Investor:innen, Nutzer:innen und unsere Zukunft.
 Als ZEV-Pionierin ist Smart Energy Link heute die führende Schweizer B2B-Plattform für Abrechnung und intelligente Steuerung dezentraler Energieinfrastruktur. Mit einem Team von rund 35 Mitarbeitenden haben wir bereits über 700 Projekte erfolgreich realisiert und betreuen mehr als 20'000 Wohneinheiten im Bereich ZEV und Metering.
 Deine Rolle 
 SEL wächst vom Start-up zum Scale-up – und du gestaltest unsere Produkte in dieser Phase aktiv mit. Als Product Lead verantwortest du unsere Webportale inklusive der Abrechnungslösung und treibst die Produktstrategie gemeinsam mit dem CEO, dem UX-Team und der Entwicklung voran. Du denkst strategisch, führst die Product Discovery und packst bei der Umsetzung mit an – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheide, echter Gestaltungsspielraum.
 Du verantwortest den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg deiner Produkte, inklusive Preisgestaltung und Markteinführung.

 Du übersetzt Kunden- und Marktbedürfnisse in eine klare Produkt-Roadmap – im Rahmen der regulatorischen Vorgaben (ZEV/vZEV/LEG).

 Du entwickelst unsere Webportale zu einer skalierbaren Plattform weiter und verantwortest die Produkt-Vision, -Strategie und -Roadmap.

 Du sorgst für die marktgerechte Weiterentwicklung der Abrechnungslösung.

 Das bringst du mit 
 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-SaaS-Plattformen, mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden und in der Skalierung. Technische Konzepte verstehst du so gut, dass du mit der Entwicklung auf Augenhöhe diskutieren kannst.

 Du bringst Erfahrung in Abrechnungs- und Inkassoprozessen mit, idealerweise in einem ZEV- (vZEV, LEG) Umfeld.

 Du kennst die Stromtarifmodelle im europäischen Raum und die regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen der Schweiz (Energiewirtschaft).

 Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und nutzt beide Sprachen im Alltag

 Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und teamorientiert

 Du hast eine hohe KI-Affinität.

 Schön, aber kein Muss: 
 Erfahrung mit Elektromobilität oder Smart Grid · Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams · technischer Studienabschluss (z. B. Informatik, Elektro-/Energietechnik) oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.
 Was wir bieten: 
 Bei SEL arbeitest du an etwas, das zählt: Du prägst die Zukunft des Schweizer Energiesektors mit – Tag für Tag.
 Bring dich ein und gestalte die Firma aktiv mit - inkl. Mitarbeiterbeteiligung.

 Wir fördern dein Lernen & Wachstum und beteiligen uns an Kursen, Aus- und Weiterbildungen.

 Wir leben Flexibilität: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbst 

 Wir arbeiten mit Jahresarbeitszeit und einer 40-Stunden-Woche.

 plus: NIKIN-Hoodie, Füürabe-Aareschwumm und Glace im Gfrüürfach

 Wir sind ein agiles Team, das sich gegenseitig schätzt, fordert und weiterbringt – offen, direkt und auf Augenhöhe. Wenn du Lust hast, wirklich etwas zu bewegen: Werde Energiepionier:in bei SEL.
 So geht's weiter 
 Bewirb dich direkt – wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage bei dir. Unser Prozess: ein kurzes Kennenlerngespräch per Telefon oder Video, ein ausführliches Interview vor Ort oder remote und ein Schnuppertag, an dem du unser Team und unsere Arbeitsweise hautnah erlebst. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören.

OUR MISSION 
 We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Agents
jobs.description:
Product Manager, Agents 
 London, 4x days per week in-office
 
 Vega is looking for A-players who will define and build the next generation of Agentic products that will shape the next era of private markets.
 
 About Vega 
 Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.
 
 Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.
 
 Who we are 
 We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.
 
 How we do it 
 Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:
 We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

 We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

 We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

 We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

 We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

 We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.
 
 Who succeeds in this role 
 We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.
 
 In this role, you will:
 Lead and partner with engineering teams on technical concepts to deliver exceptional AI-first solutions. Prototype instead of writing specs.

 Own an agentic surface end-to-end and decide what runs unattended and what needs a human.

 Keep every autonomous action explainable and reversible. Own the tradeoffs on reliability, latency and cost.

 Sit with GP and LP ops teams, find the manual work, remove it without breaking their controls.

 Operate and deliver with a sense of urgency under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment where multi-tasking, strong communication and problem-solving skills are a must.

 
 What we look for: 
 2+ years in product, ideally somewhere where being wrong is expensive.

 Hands-on with prompting, context engineering and evals. You've done it yourself, not managed someone who did.

 You've shipped LLM or agent features to real users, and can say what broke.

 Enough technical fluency to argue with engineers about retrieval and tool design. Good judgement to know when AI is the wrong answer.

 Working with GPs/LPs and/or knowledge of Fund administration, KYC/AML or LP portals is an advantage.

 
 Why join us? 
 You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

 Competitive salary and equity package

 Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

jobs.title: Team Lead Manager - Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Mission:
 Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.
 Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.
 Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.
 Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.
 
 Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here .
 
 What We’re Looking For

 We’re looking for highly technical engineers who want to lead and manage one of our engineering teams. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans, and we’re now growing from 11 to more than 14 engineering teams in the coming months. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple.
  
 As a Team Lead Manager, you’ll lead a small team of engineers. You’ll set its technical direction, line-manage and grow the people in it, and stay hands-on in the code. This is not a hands-off management role: our teams are small, and you’ll be one of the strongest engineers on yours. You’ll partner closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer to decide what to build, and you’ll be accountable for how well it’s built and how fast it ships.
  
 If you’re a strong Tech Lead who hasn’t managed people yet, we’d still love to hear from you. You can start as a Team Lead, with management handled by an Engineering Manager, and grow into the full role with our support.
  
 What Can You Expect As a Team Lead Manager?

 Lead and Manage a Small Team. Line-manage the engineers on your team, run 1:1s, give feedback, and help them take on bigger problems.

 Stay Deeply Technical. You’ll still build. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time writing code, reviewing PRs, and unblocking the hardest technical problems.

 AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude, Code, and agentic workflows every day, and our product is built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. You’ll set the bar for how your team uses them.

 Customers at the Center. Talk directly with customers to understand their problems, and make sure your team builds things that create real value for them.

 Own Technical Direction. Make the architecture and design calls for your team’s problem space, and own the trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

 Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript across the stack, React, Postgres, and AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. Datadog, Meticulous, and Incident.io round it out.

 Shape the Roadmap. Work with your PM and Designer on prioritisation, scoping, and sequencing so the team ships what matters most.

 Build the Team. Interview, hire, and onboard new engineers as we double in size.

  
 About You

 You’re a highly technical full-stack engineer. You’ve designed and shipped web apps end to end in TypeScript, ideally on AWS serverless, and you’re still one of the strongest engineers in the room.

 You’ve led engineers. You’ve been a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or TLM, owning delivery and technical direction for a team.

 You want to manage people, or grow into it. Ideally, you’ve line-managed engineers already. If not, you’re keen to learn.

 You still love to build. Leading hasn’t pulled you away from the code, and you want a role where you keep shipping.

 You raise the bar. You know what well-architected, reliable software looks like, and you help others get there through reviews, pairing, and clear feedback.

 You’re motivated by customer impact. You care about outcomes for customers, not just output, and you make good calls on what to build and what to cut.

 You’re a strong partner. You work well with product and design, push back when it matters, and bring people with you.

 You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You can take an unclear problem, shape it, and get a team moving on it.

  
 Nice-to-Haves

 You’ve led a team through fast growt

jobs.title: Scientific Product Manager
jobs.description:
About CuspAI 
 CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

 We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. 
 
 The Role 
 Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.
 
 Your impact 
 This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.
 
 What You Will Do 
 Product Requirements & Roadmap 
 Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

 Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

 Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems.

 Partner Lab Onboarding 
 Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

 Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

 Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

 Closed-Loop Campaigns 
 Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples.

 Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners.

 
 Must Have Skills and Qualifications: 
 PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.

 Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia.

 Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab.

Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We’re looking for Product Managers to join Vinted Marketplace within our Security domain. The Security domain protects member accounts and keeps the platform safe by securing sign-up and login for both individuals and businesses. We prevent fake or malicious registrations and automated bot activity, manage email/phone verification and two-factor authentication, reduce account takeovers, detect inappropriate multiple-account use, and build the core systems that power identity, verification, and additional security checks when needed.

Depending on your experience and interests, you will join one of three teams tackling meaningful problems for our business and members:

Multiple Accounts: Shape how multiple accounts and profiles work on Vinted, with an immediate priority on creating a safe, easy-to-use experience for minors and teens (including parental controls, compliance, and safety mechanisms), while expanding support for broader usage patterns.

Registration: Protect genuine users while preventing malicious actors, focusing on end-to-end registration flows, UX-first adaptive registration, and defense mechanisms against bot activity.

Verification: Own email/phone verification (2FA), identity check mechanisms, and friction platforms, ensuring seamless, scalable verification for genuine members while stopping compromised or fake accounts.

In close partnership with teams across your domain and neighboring areas, you’ll collaborate with Product Design, Product Analytics, Engineering, and cross-functional leadership to drive real impact.

  • Drive and align the vision, product strategy, and measurable OKRs for your ownership area, connecting member problems to business opportunities.
