jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Generative AI Platform
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.
  • Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.
  • Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.
  • Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.
  • Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.
  • Stay close to your customers. Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap.
  • Lead at a senior level,  presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings deep expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Significant product management experience (typically 8+ years, or equivalent), including owning a technical platform, developer product, or ML or data infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based products or platforms in production, such as assistants, agents, evaluation or inference. GenAI platforms are a young field, so we care more about depth than years.
  • A platform mindset. You notice the problem five teams keep solving and turn it into one capability everyone can use.
  • The ability to go deep with engineers and ML researchers, then explain the trade-off in plain language to a senior leader.
  • A track record of leading large, ambiguous areas on your own and aligning stakeholders across companies, countries and time zones.
  • Comfort with regular overlap with US time zones, including some late-afternoon and evening calls.

What Success Looks Like

A team in any of our three brands can go from idea to a reliable AI product dramatically faster. That happens because the hard parts (models, inference, evaluation, tooling, observability, governance and agent infrastructure) are solved once at the platform layer and get better for everyone.

Why Join Us?

  • Real scale from day one. Your platform powers AI used by millions of consumers, merchants and couriers across three brands.
  • Frontier work, real constraints. You'll work with the latest models and agent patterns, then make them reliable, affordable and compliant in production.
  • Visible impact. Platform decisions here get reviewed by senior leadership and adopted across the company.

 

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
  

 Location 
 This is a hybrid role . You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week , with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
  
 Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round

  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

München (präferiert) oder Remote in Voll- oder Teilzeit

 Baue mit uns die Weiterbildungssuche der Zukunft. 

 Wer heute eine berufliche Weiterbildung sucht, steht vor einer riesigen Auswahl und einer schwierigen Frage: Was passt wirklich zu mir und bringt mich beruflich weiter? Wir sind überzeugt, dass diese Frage digital noch nicht gut genug beantwortet wird. Mit GenauMeinKurs wollen wir das ändern. 

 Wir suchen jemanden mit Drive und dem Anspruch, die beste Weiterbildungssuche zu bauen. Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernehmen will, sich mit unserer gemeinsamen Aufgabe identifiziert und das Produkt mit eigenen Ideen und klarem Fokus voranbringt.

 Aufgaben

 Du entwickelst GenauMeinKurs zu einem vertrauenswürdigen Begleiter für den nächsten beruflichen Schritt. Daraus machst du gemeinsam mit unserem Team ein Produkt, das sich einfach anfühlt – auch wenn die Aufgabe dahinter komplex ist.

 Konkret bedeutet das:

 
 Du bist die Stimme der Nutzer im Unternehmen. Du sprichst mit ihnen, wertest Feedback und Nutzungsdaten aus und vertrittst ihre Interessen bei Produktentscheidungen.

 Du gibst der Produktentwicklung Fokus. Du erkennst aus vielen Problemen und Möglichkeiten, was wirklich zählt, setzt klare Prioritäten und entwickelst unsere Produktvision und Roadmap weiter.

 Du suchst die besten Lösungen – auch außerhalb unserer Branche. Du untersuchst, wie führende digitale Produkte Orientierung geben, Entscheidungen erleichtern und komplexe Suchen einfach machen. Relevante Erkenntnisse übersetzt du in eigene Ideen für GenauMeinKurs.

 Du denkst AI first. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich, um eigene Fragen schneller zu lösen, Ideen zu prüfen und produktiver zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du mit uns, wie AI Suche, Matching und persönliche Begleitung grundlegend verbessern kann.

 Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und die Energie mitbringst, Dinge voranzutreiben;

 Nutzerprobleme verstehen willst, bevor du Lösungen entwirfst;

 komplexe Dinge einfach erklären und gestalten kannst;

 aus vielen Möglichkeiten das Wesentliche herausfilterst und einem Team Orientierung gibst;

 über Branchengrenzen hinweg nach guten Lösungen suchst;

 LLMs sind für Dich fester Bestandteil Deines Arbeitsalltags. Prompts, APIs und Automatisierung findest du spannend – auch wenn Du selbst kein Developer bist;

 schnell lernst und gern gemeinsam mit anderen etwas aufbaust.

 
 Erfahrung im Weiterbildungsmarkt ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du Lust hast, ihn in der Tiefe zu verstehen.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

jobs.description:
What is Flagstone? 
 Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.
 Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.
  
 A feel for our culture: 
 To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.
 That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.
 We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.
 Does this sound like you? 
 You’re an experienced UX leader who gets the best out of design teams. You’ve led senior designers and managers, raised the bar on design quality, and helped teams spend their time on the right problems.
 What you’ll do 
 Reporting to the Head of UX, You’ll be accountable for the performance of your team, line managing senior individual contributors and player-coaches. You’ll set the direction for design quality, own our Design System, and lead the shift to AI-augmented ways of working. This is a leadership role rather than a squad-based design role, though you’ll roll up your sleeves where it helps the team.
 This will include:
 Leading, coaching, and developing the Product Design team, including objective setting, performance reviews, and making sure managers in your team follow good line management practice

 Embedding AI-augmented ways of working, including AI prototyping, tools, skills, and workflows

 Driving a culture of user-centred design and UI excellence, ensuring what we ship meets real user needs

 Building strong partnerships with Product, Engineering, Research, Brand, and Content, and leading stakeholders up to executive level to follow good UX practice

 Defining metrics that show the impact of design, and building business cases to grow Product Design capability

 What you’ll bring 
 Substantial UX experience, delivering successful work across product areas or programmes, with a strong focus on team leadership, stakeholder influence, and commercial awareness

 Experience line managing senior individual contributors and managers, with accountability for a design team’s performance

 Experience leading Design Ops or design system programmes

 Hands-on experience applying AI tools and workflows in design practice

 Deep experience in one or more channels, such as mobile apps, website design, or web apps

 Strong skills across UX planning and facilitation, user-centred design, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping

 Exceptional facilitation, storytelling, and influencing skills, with the confidence to adapt and find compromise in complex situations

 How we reward you: 
 At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:
 Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

 Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

 Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

 A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

 Working Abroad - Flagstone employees can work remotely from an approved list of locations for up to 90 days a year

 Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

 Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

 Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

 Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

 Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

 Matched pension contributions up to 5%

 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

 Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.
  

 All are welcome. 
 At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

jobs.description:
Build with us 
 Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.
 Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.
 With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.
 We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.
 Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.
 
 Your impact 
 As our Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll be leading go-to-market for Mollie's online payments product space. This is our core product offering and includes cards, Klarna, pay by bank and other products. You'll translate product capabilities and roadmap into positioning and coordinated marketing activity, connecting product strategy with execution across marketing, sales, and customer success.
 A key and evolving focus of this role is Agentic Commerce, an emerging area involving AI facilitated shopping that requires deep technical knowledge and strategic partnerships with entities like Visa and Mastercard. You'll play a central role in building thought leadership and developing tools such as Generative Engine Optimization to support merchants navigating this space.
 This role is particularly exciting because it ensures Mollie's core products are successfully brought to market and aligned with what customers actually need. By turning customer insight into strategic marketing initiatives, you'll directly support Mollie's commercial success.
 
 What you'll ship 
 Go to market plans built with product teams, covering technical product understanding, value and benefits, positioning, value propositions, USPs, ICPs, use cases, and messaging

 Coordinated launch activity across channel teams, bringing GTM plans to life in the market

 A launch framework covering foundations, pre-launch, launch, early momentum, proof points, and ramp-up

 Briefs, asset lists, and competitor research that support each launch

 Project timelines kept current as product readiness or market events shift

 Coordinated alignment between product and go-to-market teams when roadmap dependencies or external industry timing affect launch dates

 
 What you'll bring 
 5+ years of marketing experience, at least 3 of those in product marketing

 End-to-end go-to-market planning experience, including ICP definition, positioning, and launch timelines

 Experience in the online payments space or related areas, such as working with partners like Shopify. Prior fintech or payments exposure helps you ramp up quickly, but a strong technical product background from another vertical can also work

 Strong messaging and positioning skills, with the ability to craft compelling value propositions and clear differentiation

 Technical fluency, able to translate product specs, roadmaps, and integrations into GTM-ready language, with comfort using data platforms such as Looker, HubSpot, or other BI tools

 Experience researching competitors and industry trends, running customer interviews or surveys, and using analytics tools to measure performance and shape strategy

 Proven cross-functional project management

 Strong presentation skills for internal decks and training

 
 Grow your way 
 At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.
 You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.
 No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.
 Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy
 If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.
 Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

 We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.
 AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.description:
Vos missions

 Vos missions 

 Rattaché(e) à la Direction Technique, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction Produit. Vous définissez la stratégie produit, arbitrez les investissements, managez l'équipe et garantissez l'alignement des moyens engagés avec les objectifs de l'entreprise. 

 En binôme avec le Product Lead, vous portez la vision, fixez le cadre stratégique et représentez le produit auprès de la Direction Générale. 

 Principales responsabilités 

 * Définir la stratégie d'un portefeuille multi-produits : investissements, priorités, évolution et cycle de vie des produits.
* Appuyer chaque décision sur des données mesurables (revenus, usage, renouvellements, churn, coûts, risques).
* Manager l'équipe Produit (Product Lead, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Product Designers, QA Engineers) : recrutement, accompagnement, évaluation et développement des compétences.
* Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs clairs, stables et mesurables et faire vivre une culture produit orientée qualité et performance.
* Construire et piloter le budget de la fonction Produit ainsi que l'organisation des équipes et des squads.
* Garantir le respect des budgets et plannings, anticiper les risques et contribuer à la résolution des écarts.
* Piloter la veille concurrentielle afin d'alimenter les orientations stratégiques et les roadmaps.
* Développer l'innovation et l'usage de l'IA dans les pratiques produit (discovery, spécification, design, tests, documentation), dans un cadre sécurisé et conforme.
* Représenter le produit auprès des dirigeants et arbitrer les décisions majeures inter-équipes. 

 Environnement : Jira, Figma, Confluence, outils de data produit et solutions d'IA.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Programmatic Exchange
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Who You Are

We are seeking a results-driven Senior Product Manager / Product Manager to own key commercial and technical areas of Verve's core programmatic Marketplace. In this role, you will lead cross-functional product execution alongside Engineering, Yield, Commercial, and Operations teams, driving measurable improvements in marketplace performance, publisher yield, and DSP spend.

Depending on your background and expertise, you will take ownership of one of our core exchange areas, including mobile and in-app advertising, SDK integrations, CTV, video, or web.

What You Will Do

  • Own feature discovery, product requirements (PRDs), user stories, and clearly defined acceptance criteria.

  • Prioritize product backlogs based on revenue impact, margin protection, and operational efficiency.

  • Partner with Tech Leads, Engineering Managers, Commercial, and Yield teams to align product priorities with business goals.

  • Drive improvements across core exchange capabilities, publisher monetization, and platform integrations.

  • Monitor exchange KPIs to identify revenue challenges, feature issues, and new growth opportunities.

  • Lead product releases across cross-functional teams, ensuring clear documentation, stakeholder alignment, and communication.

What You Will Bring

  • 2+ years (Product Manager) or 4+ years (Senior Product Manager) of hands-on product management experience in programmatic advertising, including SSPs, Ad Exchanges, DSPs, or Ad Servers.

  • Strong understanding of OpenRTB protocols, RTB auction mechanics, supply chain transparency, and digital advertising formats.

  • Experience working with programmatic exchanges and a solid understanding of the supply side of the advertising ecosystem.

  • Ability to work closely with Engineering teams on technical products, platform capabilities, and integrations.

  • Experience with structured prioritization frameworks (e.g., RICE) and Agile development methodologies.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate marketplace performance metrics into product improvements.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Experience with mobile app monetization, advertising SDKs, CTV, video or web advertising technologies, or publisher integrations is a plus.

What We Offer

Just a few of the benefits waiting for you at Verve: 

  • Recharge with 3 Wellness Days throughout the year, in addition to your annual vacation and public holidays
  • Support your mental well-being with our Workplace Mental Health Solution
  • Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars, and level up your language skills through our German/English classes
  • Strengthen team connections while exploring new cultures through our monthly Work&Travel raffle, offering a chance to work from one of our global offices (after 2 years of employment)
  • … and even more reasons to join us!

Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

 We're reinventing how trading and investing work by building exceptional products people love.

 Use LLMs and prototyping tools to explore ideas, test assumptions and accelerate your work, checking the quality of their output.

 Outstanding academic performance. An achieved First-Class degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, Finance or another highly quantitative subject from a top university, placing you in the top 10% of your cohort.

 Exceptional analytical reasoning. You work confidently with numbers, distinguish signal from noise and reach defensible conclusions from incomplete information.

 Strong product judgment. You can explain what makes a product excellent, identify where an experience falls short and propose a simpler solution with clear trade-offs.

 Evidence of exceptional initiative. You've taken a demanding idea beyond the brief and produced something tangible through an academic, personal or extracurricular project. You can explain your decisions, what you learned and what you would improve.

 Outstanding written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex problem into a concise, structured explanation and defend your recommendation under questioning.

 Technical fluency. You understand how software products work, can use SQL to answer questions from data, and can build a simple prototype to communicate or test an idea.

 Proficient, critical use of LLMs. You use them effectively for research, analysis and prototyping, recognise their limitations and independently verify important outputs.

 Fast learning and intellectual honesty. You get up to speed quickly, seek demanding feedback and change your mind when the evidence warrants it.

 A strong interest in investing and financial products. You're curious about how they work and how to make them easier for people to understand and use.

 Full-time availability and willingness to work in-office.

 Distinction in a highly competitive academic competition, Olympiad, hackathon or research award.

 Strong foundations in statistics, probability and experimental design.

jobs.description:
About us 
 Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!
 
 
 
 Mission of this role 
 Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct.
 
 Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there.
 
 Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there.
 
 What you'll do 
 Own Transport end to end: Running the full release train for your value stream: discovery, scoping, design, development, launch and post-launch tracking.

 Run customer discovery yourself, in the field: Talk to rental companies about how they plan, staff and execute transport today: warehouse-to-venue routing, multi-stop and multi-vehicle loads, load order, crew and vehicle capacity, and the constraints that make equipment transport harder than generic delivery routing.

 Define the first sellable increment. Find the smallest thing customers will genuinely pay for, ship it, and be able to explain why that slice was the right first bet.

 Build and own a sequenced, evidence-based roadmap with the Head of Product, aligned to company goals and product strategy. And explain the prioritisation to sales, support and management so they can plan against it.

 Translate routing and logistics complexity into buildable scope: multi-stop optimisation, time windows, vehicle and crew capacity, mapping and routing APIs, and the build-vs-buy decisions that come with them.

 Define success before you build it: Every feature carries a business goal, product briefs stay current, a live dashboard goes up at launch, and you drive go-to-market together with Product Marketing, Support, Sales and Content & Community.
 

 
 
 What we are looking for 
 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS.

 You've owned a product area end to end. From discovery through launch and post-launch tracking, not a backlog-only PO role.

 You're comfortable with operationally complex problems: routing, scheduling, fleet or capacity planning, supply chain, field service. A logistics background is a plus, not a must.

 You work from data. You can show how you set a success metric, what you did when it was missed, and how you make the business case behind a product call.

 You've run customer discovery yourself, not through a research team, and you can make and defend scope calls on partial evidence.
 

 Nice to haves 
 Product experience in route optimisation, fleet management, field service or supply chain / TMS, or hands-on experience with mapping and routing APIs and platforms (Google Maps Platform, HERE, Mapbox, route-optimisation engines).

 Experience building a product domain or team from scratch (0-to-1), not only taking one over.

 Experience in the live event, AV or equipment rental industry, and/or Dutch, German or French.

jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren project manager die impact wil maken binnen een snelgroeiend softwarebedrijf? Wil jij het verschil maken bij klanten op het gebied van personeelsplanning en personeelskrapte? Heb jij de kennis en vaardigheden om projecten efficiënt te managen en tegelijkertijd de klanttevredenheid hoog te houden? Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten om het team te versterken en samen optimale resultaten te behalen? Dan kijken we ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten!   
 
Werken bij een van de Top 3 spelers in Workforce management in Nederland en bijdragen aan snelle ontwikkeling in het buitenland? 
Bij Intus helpen wij onze klanten en hun medewerkers met slimmer plannen. Hierdoor dragen we bij aan het oplossen van één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke uitdagingen: personeelskrapte. 
 Onze producten brengen flexibiliteit en efficiëntie in het planningsproces en dat is fijn voor iedereen. Onze klanten kunnen onze medewerkers optimaal inzetten, terwijl we tegelijkertijd bijdragen aan meer werkgeluk en een gezonde werk-privé balans. Een win-win voor iedereen! 
 
Als project manager bij Intus speel je een cruciale rol in projecten bij onze diverse klanten in verschillende markten zoals zorg, overheid, industrie en logistiek . Je structureert en realiseert meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd van begin tot het eind. Dit kan gaan om het begeleiden van onze klanten bij het volledig implementeren van onze software InPlanning bij een nieuwe klant of het begeleiden van een complexe transformatie in het applicatielandschap bij een bestaande klant. Ook interne projecten kunnen onderdeel van de werkzaamheden zijn. Dankzij jouw vermogen om draagvlak te creëren en overzicht te behouden, help je klanten en zorg je voor een efficiënt verloop van de projecten.  
 
Je maakt deel uit van een team van project managers en consultants die verantwoordelijk zijn voor alle projecten in Nederland. Als project manager ben jij tijdens een project hét aanspreekpunt voor de klant, met betrekking tot de voortgang, planning, kwaliteit, budget en uitvoering. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s (o.a. implementatie consultants en technisch consultants) om de projecten te realiseren, en daarnaast heb je ook regelmatig contact met je collega-project managers, accountmanagers, technisch consultants en product owners. Kortom, een boeiende functie in een dynamische werkomgeving!  
 
 Als project manager begeleidt je projecten van A tot Z wat betekent dat je de volgende verantwoordelijkheden hebt:   
 Opstellen van een Plan van Aanpak en een implementatieagenda.  

 Plannen van projectwerkzaamheden van consultants.  

 Zorgdragen voor een goede samenwerking tussen alle interne en externe stakeholders van het project.  

 Tijdig signaleren en rapporteren van risico's, op basis waarvan je een concrete aanpak voorstelt op basis waarvan besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.  

 Bewaken van kaders waaronder projectdoelen, kwaliteit, budgetten en planningen.  

 Verzorgen van maandrapportages en voorbereiding van de facturatie richting de klant.  

 Overzicht behouden over meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd.  

 
 Je hebt uitgebreide werkervaring als project manager, bij voorkeur in de gezondheidszorg. 

 Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding.  

 Je hebt een pro-actieve werkhouding en neemt verantwoordelijkheid.  

 Je bent een echte teamspeler en weet hoe je effectief stakeholders kunt betrekken.  

 Je werkt gestructureerd en hebt een helikopterview.  

 Je bent resultaatgericht, maar verliest de kwaliteit niet uit het oog.  

 Je bent gedreven, slim, analytisch en bent in staat op verschillende niveaus te denken en te handelen.  

 Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal op professioneel niveau, mondeling en schriftelijk. Beheers je daarnaast ook nog Duits? Dan is dat de kers op de taart! 

   
 Bij Intus hechten we veel waarde aan een informele, maar professionele werksfeer. Maar er is meer dat ons bijzonder maakt! Hier is ons DNA in een kort overzicht:   
 Trots;  op ons product, onze klanten én onze collega’s!   

 Goede vibe; een gezellige sfeer waar iedere mening telt.   

 Open cultuur;  jazeker, met korte lijnen en weinig hiërarchie.   

 Collegialiteit;  we helpen elkaar en hebben lol met elkaar. Heb je een last-minute vraag? Je vindt altijd iemand die wil helpen.   

 Ambitieus; w at we tot nu toe hebben gedaan is geweldig, maar we zijn nog lang niet klaar!   

   
 En verder bieden we:    
 Een goed salaris 

 Een zinvolle baan : deel uitmaken van een organisatie die het werkleven van 200.000 mensen gemakkelijker maakt   

 Gratis lunch en fruit : we eten allemaal gezamenlijk als je op kantoor bent   

 Verschillende ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden !   

 Je kunt zowel bij de klant, op kantoor of thuis werken   

 Een leuk en gezellig kantoorgelegen naast station Driebergen-Zeist   

 Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget :)

jobs.description:
About Voodoo
 Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.
 
 Team
 The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile gaming industry.
 Helix is our flagship Ad-Network team of around 60 top-tier engineers and data scientists spanning backend, mobile SDKs, data engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Helix has evolved beyond powering Voodoo's own gaming portfolio—our technology is now directly integrated into games from external, third-party publishers worldwide.
 Operating across millions of third-party devices in real-time bidding environments creates unique technical challenges around SDK performance, ultra-low latency, and intelligent automation.
 Within Helix, you'll join the RTB team, the group that owns the bidder and the services behind it that help it take the optimal bidding decision. Bidder, pricing, models and data are all built in-house, so nothing is out of reach when you want to change how a bid gets made. You will work with expert backend and machine-learning engineers in real-time bidding, on a system that prices ad requests across mobile gaming in real time, at a scale few teams get to work at.
 
 Role
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - Real Time Bidding to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you’ll drive product decisions across the full bidding pipeline.
 You'll own projects end-to-end: roadmap, trade-offs, shipping, and cross-team contract. You will also:
 Own the roadmap of the bidding pipeline. How we target, price, pace and cap, and what goes live in the bid path and when.

 Own the delivery. Adapt to changes, set clear priorities, communicate effectively

 Own experimentation as a product. Other teams test ideas on the bidder through the framework we build. You make sure they can run the experiments they need, trust the results, and get an answer fast.

 Keep the pieces fitting together. You spot a change in one team that will break another before it reaches production.

 Contribute to the product strategy beyond your scope.

 
 Profile (Must have)
 Experience in programmatic advertising. You have worked on pricing, bidding or auction logic on a DSP, bidder or exchange, you know the pipeline from bid request to win, and you can explain the business impact of your work.

 Analytical mindset. You back decisions with data and understand the statistical basis of pricing and experimentation.

 You own outcomes across teams. When a change in one team is about to break another, you catch it and drive the fix before it ships.

 You use AI tooling daily to write specs, analyse data and prototype, and you move faster because of it.

 
 Profile (Nice to have)
 Mobile user acquisition: app install campaigns, attribution or mediation.

 Experience working with ML or data science teams.

 Supply-side experience: ad exchange or SSP.

 Background in statistics, operations research or economics.

 
 Benefits
 Competitive salary based on experience

 Swile Lunch voucher

 Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

 Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

 Wellness activities in our Paris office

 Remote Fridays

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
jobs.description:
Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager in our Berlin or London offices.
 
 About the Role
 Taktile is building the world's leading Agentic Decisioning Platform for Financial Services. Our customers use our product to automate millions of critical decisions with AI across customer onboarding, credit underwriting, anti money laundering, and many other use cases.
 Underneath every one of these decisions sits the Taktile Platform: the permissions, environments, deployment, extensibility and connectivity foundations that allow the largest financial institutions to run Taktile securely and at scale, for both humans and AI agents. Taktile Platform also owns developer productivity: the tooling, infrastructure and workflows that help our engineering teams ship quickly and safely. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the strategy and roadmap for the platform, with a focus on its enterprise and agentic foundations. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure and security engineering to meet the demands of a rapidly growing enterprise customer base, and partner with customer-facing teams and Product Marketing to make our platform a reason customers choose Taktile.
 
 What You’ll Do
 Own the strategy and long-term success of the Taktile Platform, the foundation that every product area and every enterprise customer builds on

 Define a compelling long-term vision for the platform and prioritize the roadmap necessary to reach it. Example areas of focus will include permissions for users and AI agents, Taktile MCP extensibility, release processes (e.g. environments), enterprise connectivity, and more

 Build a deep understanding of enterprise requirements (security, IT, compliance and procurement), the competitive landscape and opportunities for differentiation, collaborating with customer-facing teams

 Translate customer insights into well thought out product requirements

 Balance innovation with a very high bar for reliability and security

 Act as the voice of the platform: enable and advocate for platform capabilities across product, engineering and go-to-market teams, and partner with Product Marketing to bring them to market

 Track adoption and performance of platform capabilities through metrics and customer feedback, identifying opportunities for iteration

 
 Who You Are

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Germany.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will: 

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
  • Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
  • Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Functieomschrijving 
 Als Product Owner Interne Automatisering & IT ben jij de onmisbare brug tussen de business en ons IT-landschap. Je haalt de wensen en requirements op bij verschillende afdelingen en het Management Team, en vertaalt deze naar slimme, efficiënte automatiseringen. Waar anderen een complex proces zien, zie jij een kans om zaken sneller, beter en soepeler te laten verlopen. 
 In deze rol schakel je veel met interne stakeholders om processen echt te doorgronden. Vervolgens bepaal je hoe we onze tools, waaronder ons ERP-systeem Odoo en Camunda, optimaal kunnen inzetten. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met onze Applicatiebeheerder, die het functionele beheer voor zijn rekening neemt en onze Camunda/Python Developer. Omdat onze developer ook eigen projecten draait, is het fantastisch als jij zelf de taal van developers spreekt of zelfs je eigen Python-code kunt kloppen om snel iets te bouwen of testen. 
 
 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden 
 Ophalen, analyseren en in kaart brengen van requirements bij diverse afdelingen en de MT-laag. 

 Vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen en wensen naar concrete automatiseringsoplossingen. 

 Beheren, prioriteren en structureren van de interne IT-backlog. 

 Samenwerken met de interne Camunda/Python developer en de Applicatiebeheerder om projecten succesvol en vlot op te leveren. 

 Adviseren van de business over procesoptimalisaties en nieuwe automatiseringskansen. 

 Zorgdragen voor een soepele implementatie en adoptie van nieuwe functionaliteiten op de werkvloer. 

 
 Over Payter 
 Bij Payter zijn we pioniers op het gebied van contactloze NFC- en cashless-technologie. Sinds 2007 maken we impact: we hebben het grootste Europese proefproject voor contactloze en mobiele betalingen gelanceerd, en sindsdien maken bedrijven over de hele wereld gebruik van onze oplossingen. We combineren innovatieve technologieën om veilige, duurzame en toekomstbestendige producten te ontwikkelen. Bij Payter krijg je de kans om bij te dragen aan slimme oplossingen die écht verschil maken in een snel veranderende wereld. 
 
 Je hebt hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en een sterke interesse in IT en bedrijfsprocessen. 

 Je bent communicatief vaardig, stapt makkelijk op mensen af en kunt goed schakelen met zowel de business als technische collega's. 

 Je snapt hoe bedrijfsprocessen lopen en wordt oprecht enthousiast van het automatiseren hiervan. 

 Je hebt (basis)kennis van Python; het is een hele mooie bonus als je zelf ook af en toe wat code kunt schrijven. 

 Je hebt bij voorkeur kennis van of interesse in ERP-systemen (zoals Odoo) 

 Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en pakt graag de regie om projecten van wens tot realiteit te brengen. 

 Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

 Ruimte voor professionele ontwikkeling met trainingen en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden

 12 balancedays voor een goede werk-privébalans

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are 
 You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.
 We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.
 Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.
 Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.
 Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.
 The Problem You'll Solve 
 Prosus is building an AI-first future across a global portfolio that spans food delivery, e-commerce, fintech, and education. We invest over $100 million annually in AI, run 800+ models in production, and have deployed Toqan — our internal platform for building, testing, and deploying GenAI and agentic workflows — across the organisation. The scale of ambition is real; the challenge now is focus, coherence, and velocity.
 As Group Product Manager for our AI Platform, you will own the multi-year product strategy for the platform that underpins every AI initiative across Prosus. This means defining and sequencing the roadmap for agent infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, model deployment pipelines, and the shared capabilities that internal teams — from applied science to application engineering — rely on to build and ship AI products. You will balance long-term platform investments against the immediate, high-impact needs of teams across the portfolio who are racing to deliver.
 You will lead and mentor a team of product managers, instilling product discipline and building the PM talent pipeline that scales with the platform. You will partner closely with engineering and applied science leadership to shape the technical strategy — making the hard trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and reliability that determine what we can promise the business.
 And you will be the connective tissue: the person who turns ambiguous, fast-moving business needs into clear requirements, who aligns stakeholders across functions and geographies, and who ensures that what we build is not just technically impressive but adopted, trusted, and measurably impactful.
 
 Who You Are 
 You are a senior product leader who has lived through the messy reality of building platform products for internal teams — and loved it. You measure your success not by features shipped but by the velocity and quality of the teams who build on top of your platform.
 
 You are deeply technical. You can engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on model lifecycle, MLOps, evaluation frameworks, and infrastructure trade-offs — not as a bystander, but as a thought partner. You understand agentic architectures, LLM capabilities and limitations, and the operational realities of running AI in production at scale.
 
 You are a people leader. You have managed and mentored product managers, and you take genuine pride in their growth. You set strategic direction, coordinate overlapping roadmaps into a coherent plan, and create the clarity that lets your team operate with autonomy and purpose.
 
 You thrive in ambiguity. You have worked in fast-paced, high-scale environments where priorities shift and the path forward is not always clear. You do not wait for perfect information — you run rapid experiments, test hypotheses, and let data and user feedback guide the next step.
 
 You are a communicator. You can simplify complex technical concepts for executive leadership one hour and dig into detailed requirements with an engineering team the next. You build trust across functions and geographies, and you are as comfortable pushing back as you are building consensus.
 
 You are customer-obsessed — even when your customers are internal teams. You connect frequently with the people who use your platform, validate solutions through product discovery, and treat adoption as a first-class metric.
 
 What You Bring 
 8+ years in product management, with at least 3–5 years in formal people-management roles leading a team of product managers.

 Demonstrated success owning platform-level or infrastructure products used by internal teams — ideally including AI/ML platform capabilities, MLOps tooling, or developer-facing services.

Project Manager
 Location: Alkmaar, Netherlands
 Working Arrangement: 5 Days Onsite, Alkmaar Office
 
 Join Our Team as a Project Manager at Beyond Sports
 If you’re someone who thrives on bringing people, technology, and clients together, enjoys taking ownership of projects from start to finish, and gets energy from delivering high-quality digital products, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.
 At Beyond Sports, you’ll work on innovative consumer-facing products and experiences within the sports world, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to turn ideas and client requirements into successful deliveries.
 
 What Your Day Will Look Like
 As a Project Manager within the Beyond Sports Delivery Team, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of consumer-facing software projects, including websites, mobile applications, data visualizations, and other digital sports experiences.
 You’ll take ownership of scoping, planning, budgeting, and project delivery, while making sure projects stay on track and meet the quality our clients and users expect. You’ll work closely with our Design, Engineering, and QA teams, facilitating collaboration and ensuring everyone has the clarity they need to deliver successfully.
 You’ll also be a key point of contact for our external clients. From translating customer requirements and feedback into clear scopes, functional requirements, and user stories to managing expectations, risks, and project progress, you’ll make sure communication stays clear throughout the entire project lifecycle.
 When our products go live, you’ll be there too, acting as a central point of communication and helping coordinate and escalate where necessary during live events.
 
 What We Value
 At Beyond Sports, we value people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
 As a Project Manager, you’ll need to be proactive and organised, while also being able to adapt your approach depending on the project, client, and team you’re working with. You should be comfortable managing several projects at once and confident bringing together different perspectives to keep everyone moving towards the same goal.
 We’re looking for someone who understands the world of technology and software development and can comfortably translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience working with data-driven products or projects is particularly valuable for this role.
 While this role is based in Alkmaar, Netherlands, we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, so we expect you to be available for 32–40 hours per week in the office .
 
 Skills and Experience
 You don’t need to tick every box, but here’s what we’re looking for:
 Proven experience managing software or digital projects from start to finish, ideally including consumer-facing products such as websites, mobile applications, or data visualization products

 Experience with project scoping, planning, budgeting, and resource coordination

 Strong understanding of software development processes and working with multidisciplinary teams across Design, Engineering, and QA

 Experience translating customer requirements and feedback into clear scopes, functional requirements, and user stories

 Strong client and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to act as the main point of contact throughout project delivery

 Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 Experience managing project risks, issues, reporting, documentation, and delivery progress

 The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and attention to detail

 A proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving

 Strong collaboration and facilitation skills, with the ability to bring teams and stakeholders together around decisions

 The confidence to negotiate, manage expectations, and resolve conflicts professionally when needed

 Experience working with project management and delivery tools such as Azure DevOps and Jira 

 Familiarity with modern AI tools such as Copilot and Claude

 A good understanding of data or data-driven products is strongly preferred

 
 Nice to have: 
 Experience with tools such as Figma and Trello 

 Experience working within the sports, media, broadcast, or technology industry

 Experience supporting the delivery of live products or events

 Experience identifying and implementing improvements to delivery processes and ways of working

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

Planet is expanding its platform capabilities to support customers who require dedicated, in-region, or on-premises instantiations of our core platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Sovereign & Hybrid Deployments, you will drive the productization of our platform for isolated, air-gapped, and hybrid environments.

You will serve as the critical bridge between high-touch enterprise customer delivery and scalable core engineering. In this role, you will balance deep customer empathy with product discipline—translating complex operational requirements into repeatable core platform capabilities while establishing clear extension points for Professional Services.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Conduct deep-dive discovery with high-security enterprise and government stakeholders to understand their operational realities, using those insights to set clear, defensible product priorities.
  • Define and structure the explicit, phased customer journey framework—establishing the operational models, readiness criteria, and governance standards for initial platform installation, joint-operations training, and the final transition into fully autonomous, customer-operated environments with zero or limited vendor access.
  • Translate customer operational and security requirements into clear technical specifications for Core Infrastructure and Engineering teams with detail-oriented accuracy. Synthesizes underlying commonalities across clients who describe similar operational needs using different language, preventing costly, redundant engineering effort.
  • Define standardized building blocks that allow the core platform to extend safely into varying edge and air-gapped environments without hardcoding custom variants for every deployment.
  • Define clear boundaries for what belongs in the core platform versus what can be customized. Design clear hooks and interfaces so Professional Services and integration partners can build custom extensions without modifying core platform code.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of relevant work experience in Technical Product Management focusing on enterprise platforms, hybrid cloud deployments, or complex infrastructure products.
  • Ability to sit down with enterprise or government clients, listen to complex operational workflows, and identify the root problem behind divergent customer terminology.
  • Track record productizing cloud-native software platforms to deploy into customer-managed infrastructure, enterprise VPCs, or air-gapped data centers.
  • Ability to apply conceptual understanding of enterprise hybrid patterns similar to AWS Outposts, Azure Stack, Kubernetes-based enterprise distribution platforms (e.g., Red Hat OpenShift), or infrastructure automation frameworks (e.g., HashiCorp Terraform/Vault).
  • Experience setting clear boundaries between core platform roadmap items and custom extensions delivered by Professional Services.
  • Detail-oriented mindset capable of mapping out complex operational transitions, training milestones, and access handoffs.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Prior experience navigating European sovereign cloud frameworks, regional data residency mandates, or EU defense/government compliance standards.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Search & Ranking
jobs.description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your mission

Every Product Manager at Catawiki owns a meaningful part of the customer experience.

In Search and Ranking, your mission is to help buyers find the special objects they care about. You will shape how search, ranking and personalisation work across the buyer journey, making discovery more relevant and helping more buyers find objects they love.

This is a broad product area. It brings together buyer needs, expert curation, marketplace priorities, search experiences and machine learning. You will identify the most important opportunities, set a clear direction and lead a cross functional team from insight to measurable customer and business impact.

The solution is not prescribed. You may improve search relevance, ranking, recommendations or personalisation, or explore new AI enabled ways to help buyers discover objects. What matters is that you solve a meaningful customer problem, measure the impact and scale what works.

You will own the strategy, outcomes and execution for this area, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing and Commercial teams.

What you will do

  1. Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for Search and Ranking.
  2. Own measurable outcomes across search relevance, discovery, engagement and buyer conversion.
  3. Use behavioural data, customer research and commercial insight to identify and prioritise the biggest opportunities.
  4. Turn ambiguous customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, prototypes and executable plans.
  5. Lead initiatives from early discovery through experimentation, launch and scaling.
  6. Define success metrics and build a rigorous experimentation agenda for search, ranking and personalisation.
  7. Work with machine learning engineers and data scientists to assess model quality, test new approaches and improve customer outcomes.
  8. Improve the relevance of search results and recommendations across the buyer journey.
  9. Integrate personalisation into the customer experience in ways that feel useful, coherent and trustworthy.
  10. Design, run and evaluate experiments, using positive, negative and inconclusive results to guide decisions.
  11. Use AI and rapid prototyping to test ideas early, reduce development risk and accelerate learning.
  12. Create clarity, momentum and accountability across teams, including when priorities or incentives differ.
  13. Communicate strategy, performance, tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to senior and C level stakeholders.

Who you are

Three qualities matter most in this role.

Outcome ownership

You take responsibility for customer and business results, not only for delivering features. You stay with the problem, remove obstacles and change direction when the evidence calls for it.

Systems thinking

You understand how search, ranking, recommendations, auction dynamics, expert curation and marketplace health influence one another. You make thoughtful decisions across the full buyer journey.

Experimental rigour

You use data, research, prototypes and controlled experiments to make decisions. You learn from negative results and can distinguish meaningful progress from activity.

You will also bring:

  1. At least five years of product management experience, preferably in consumer ecommerce, marketplaces or another digital product at scale.
  2. Experience owning a broad product area or customer journey, rather than only individual features.
  3. Experience defining product strategy or roadmaps for search, ranking, recommendations, personalisatio
