jobs.title: Product Manager - Device Data Management (Fluent French & English)
jobs.description:
Job title: Product Manager - Device Data Management (Fluent French & English) 

Location: Paris — Hybrid (3 days in office)

Salary: €57,600 - €72,000

Team: Product Management - Data Device Management 

Reporting to: Group Product Manager

This role is based in Paris, France and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to Paris. Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position. 

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship

Please submit your profile in English. 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

You'll lead the French localisation of Device Data Management — one of the core product areas within the Kaluza platform that brings together data on supplies, meters, registers, reads and consumption. This area also covers the journeys around managing this data (like updating a meter's configuration), the APIs that expose it, the frontend pages that surface it to users, and the calculations behind consumption projection and forecasting. This is a hands-on, full-stack product role — you'll work across the whole product area, from the data model through to what users see on screen.

  • Translate French market requirements into clear specifications — turn the rules of the French energy market (including how device and meter data flows between grid operators and suppliers) into detailed product requirements covering compliance, data flows and data quality.
  • Build close working relationships — work hand in hand with key partners in the French market to understand their needs, shape requirements together, and build the kind of trusted relationship where they come to you first, using that closeness to steer what we build next for France.
  • Build, don't just specify. Go from idea to working prototype yourself — query data, sketch API contracts, and stand up proofs of concept. We expect you to use AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code) as a daily multiplier to prototype, investigate, and unblock, not just to draft documents.
  • Align global and local teams across all functions — partner closely with engineering, UX, QA and more, with full-stack influence, keeping everyone pointed at the right outcomes. Be the go-to person for this product area in France, and act as the link between our global and local teams to inform priorities and strategy.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, Business Analyst, or equivalent role in software companies, with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets
  • Previous experience in the French energy industry — you know how the market works and its key players (e.g. Enedis / GRDF), especially around device data and market flows. Experience with energy management or utility platforms in the French market is a strong plus.
  • Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.
  • Confident working directly with clients — you can run a working session with client stakeholders, draw out the real requirement behind the ask, and keep senior people aligned and brought

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbezeichnung – Senior Technical Project Manager 
 Unternehmen – iwell – Your Partner for Sustainable Energy Solutions 
 Standort – Homeoffice-basiert, mit regelmäßigen Besuchen im Düsseldorfer Büro
 
 
 Über iwell 
 Bei iwell dreht sich alles um die Stärkung der Energiesicherheit. Wir helfen europäischen Unternehmen, unabhängiger in ihrer Energieversorgung zu werden. Denn angesichts wachsender regulatorischer Anforderungen, extremer Preisschwankungen und zunehmender Netzprobleme müssen sie einfach widerstandsfähiger werden. Es ist also Zeit, die Initiative zu ergreifen und vorausschauend zu denken.
 
 
 Wir bieten Energiemanagementsysteme, die sicherstellen, dass Unternehmen jederzeit die Kontrolle über ihre Energie behalten. Unser intern entwickeltes EMS und modularer Batteriespeicher steigern durch Nachhaltigkeit die Rentabilität und machen Unternehmen zukunftssicher. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes, internationales Team aus mutigen, talentierten Menschen. Von Ingenieuren und Softwareentwicklern bis hin zu kreativen Köpfen und kundenorientierten Business Developern – wir suchen Menschen, die entschlossen sind, einen positiven Beitrag zu leisten.
 
 
 Als Pionier: in im deutschen Markt trägst Du direkt zur Energiewende in Deutschland bei und arbeitest eng mit dem Head of Projects und seinem Team in den Niederlanden zusammen.
 
 
 Die Rolle 
 Als Senior Technical Project Manager übernimmst Du die technische und operative Verantwortung für unsere komplexesten Kundenprojekte im deutschen Markt – von der frühen Anbahnung über die Vertragsunterzeichnung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme. 
 Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Installateuren, Lieferanten und unseren internen Teams in den Niederlanden. 
 Dein Beitrag sorgt dafür, dass anspruchsvolle Batterieprojekte termingerecht, budgetgerecht und in hoher Qualität realisiert werden. 

 
 Technisches Projektmanagement & Kundenbetreuung 
 Leitung neuer und komplexer Kundenprojekte in Deutschland, von der Anbahnung bis zur Übergabe 

 Frühzeitige Einbindung in neue Projekte, um technische Fragestellungen von Kunden und Partnern zu klären 

 Anwendung eines risikobasierten Ansatzes: Übersetzung kundenspezifischer Anforderungen in strukturierte technische Vorgaben 

 Eskalation von Produktlücken oder systemischen Problemen an die richtigen internen Stellen 

 Steuerung eines komplexen externen Stakeholderfelds – Kunden, Installateure, Auftragnehmer, Lieferanten 

 Projektkoordination & Umsetzung 
 Koordination aller relevanten internen und externen Stakeholder nach Vertragsabschluss 

 Zeitplanung, Bestellvorgänge, Installationsabläufe und Reporting durchgehend im Blick behalten 

 Sicherstellen, dass Projekte hohe Qualitätsstandards und Deadlines einhalten 

 Enge Begleitung von Installation und Inbetriebnahme, inklusive Validierung der Systemleistung 

 Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit 
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Engineering, Field Operations und Customer Operations 

 Weitergabe von Felderfahrungen aus dem deutschen Markt an das Produktteam in den Niederlanden 

 Als erfahrene Ansprechperson im Technical Project Management Team fungieren und jüngere Kolleg:innen unterstützen 

 Marktaufbau Deutschland 
 Aktive Mitgestaltung des Aufbaus des deutschen Teams und der lokalen Arbeitsweisen 

 Einbringen neuer Perspektiven, um Prozesse zu verbessern und den deutschen Markt zu skalieren
 
 

 Was wir suchen 
 Fachlich 
 Studium im Elektroingenieurwesen mit Schwerpunkt Energie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation 

 Mehrjährige (idealerweise 5+ Jahre) Erfahrung im Management komplexer (elektro-)technischer Installationsprojekte 

 Erfahrung im Bereich Batteriesysteme, Energiespeicher oder erneuerbare Energien von Vorteil 

 Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch 

 Persönlich 
 Du denkst proaktiv und behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick 

 Du arbeitest strukturiert, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert 

 Du übernimmst Verantwortung für ein vielfältiges Stakeholderfeld und triffst Entscheidungen 

 Du fühlst dich wohl in einem dynamischen, grenzüberschreitenden Arbeitsumfeld 

 Standort & Mobilität 
 Wohnsitz in Deutschland; Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands sowie zu Branchenmessen und Networking-Veranstaltungen im In- und Ausland, wenn erforderlich 

 Gelegentliche Reisen zu unserem Hauptsitz in Utrecht, Niederlande, gehören zur Rolle 

 Büropräsenz an 3–4 Tagen pro Monat
 
 

 Was wir bieten 
 Variable Vergütung zusätzlich zu Deinem monatlichen Gehalt 

 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus einen jährlichen dreitägigen Firmenausflug 

 1 freiwilliger Tag pro Jahr, um Dich ehrenamtlich zu engagieren 

 Ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 € pro Kalenderjahr für persönliche Entwicklung und Karrierewachstum 

 Attraktive Altersvorsorge bei Allianz mit einem Arbeitgeberanteil von 5 % 

 Freie, aber nicht verpflichtende tägliche Nutzung unseres deutschen Büros – Anwesenheit ist erforderlich bei regelmäßigen, im Voraus

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 What You'll Own
 Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

 Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

 Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

 Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

 Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

 Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

 Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation
 

 What We're Looking For
 Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

 Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

 Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

 AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

 Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
 

 Outcome
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. 

 This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 

 MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. 

 AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. 

 You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. 

 The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 , made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. 
 

 About MoonPay Enterprise

 MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.

 KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome.

 What You'll Own

 KYB product strategy & roadmap

 
 
 Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners.

 
 Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation.

 
 MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order.

 
 Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation.

 
 Onboarding funnel & conversion

 
 
 The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step.

 
 Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both.

 
 Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on.

 
 KYB API & partner experience

 
 
 The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once).

 
 Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it.

 
 Compliance as product

 
 
 Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix.

 
 EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product.

 
 Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy.

 
 Vendor & provider orchestration

Company Overview: 

 At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning , we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career. 

 
 

 Panopto is looking for a Senior Project Manager to own the execution behind our product initiatives — from the moment we commit to something through the day customers can use it. 

 Position Summary 

 In this role, you will have the opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning. 

 As the Senior Project Manager, you'll report to the Program Manager and sit inside the Product team on the R&D side, which means the job runs in both directions. Upstream, you're working with Product Managers, Engineering, and Design to keep committed work moving, dependencies visible, and slippage caught early. Downstream, you're making sure Marketing has positioning, Support knows what's changing, Sales can sell it, and customers hear about it the day it goes live. 

 

 Most project management roles are one or the other. This one is deliberately both, because the handoffs between them are where things fall apart. 

 You'll take initiatives that start as a paragraph and a target quarter, break them into a plan people can act on, and keep a distributed group of teams moving in the same direction until it's out the door. This role is for someone energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity — you'll frequently be the person who turns "we're doing this next quarter" into a sequenced plan with owners and dates, and then holds everyone to it. 

 You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft. 

 How You’ll Contribute 

 In this role, you will have the opportunity to 

 
 
 Own the end-to-end plan for assigned initiatives — scope, sequence, dependencies, milestones, and readiness criteria from commitment through release. 

 
 Break large, ambiguous initiatives into discrete workstreams with clear owners, and keep the group aligned as things shift. 

 
 Work alongside Product Managers and Engineering Leads to track delivery against commitments, surface slippage early, and keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved. 

 
 Facilitate the sessions that move work forward — dependency reviews, cross-team planning, release readiness — and make sure they end in decisions.

 Drive go-to-market readiness with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Support, and Customer Success so enablement lands with the release, not after it. 

 
 Coordinate internal and customer-facing release communications, including release notes.

 What Success Looks Like 

 
 
 Within 3 months: You've built working relationships across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support, and you own end-to-end coordination for two or more active initiatives — running the delivery cadence with the dev teams and producing status reporting people actually read. 

 
 Within 6 months: You're anticipating blockers rather than reporting them, and releases you coordinate go out with GTM readiness in place on day one. 

 
 Within 1 year: You run our most complex, multi-team initiatives with minimal oversight, and the delivery and launch process you've built is what the rest of the team uses by default. 

 
 Your legacy: Panopto ships predictably, and every team knows what's coming and what they need to do about it — because you built the system that makes that true. 

 
 Values in Action 

 
 
 Customer First, Always : You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports. 

 
 Thrive Together : You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

 Act with Ownership : You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

 Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.

 We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.

 What You'll Be Doing

 
 Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.

 Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.

 Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.

 Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.

 Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.

 Stay close to your customers. Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap.

 Lead at a senior level, presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap.

 
 What You'll Need to Thrive

 Our ideal candidate brings deep expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

 
 Significant product management experience (typically 8+ years, or equivalent), including owning a technical platform, developer product, or ML or data infrastructure.

 Hands-on experience with LLM-based products or platforms in production, such as assistants, agents, evaluation or inference. GenAI platforms are a young field, so we care more about depth than years.

 A platform mindset. You notice the problem five teams keep solving and turn it into one capability everyone can use.

 The ability to go deep with engineers and ML researchers, then explain the trade-off in plain language to a senior leader.

 A track record of leading large, ambiguous areas on your own and aligning stakeholders across companies, countries and time zones.

 Comfort with regular overlap with US time zones, including some late-afternoon and evening calls.

 
 What Success Looks Like

 A team in any of our three brands can go from idea to a reliable AI product dramatically faster. That happens because the hard parts (models, inference, evaluation, tooling, observability, governance and agent infrastructure) are solved once at the platform layer and get better for everyone.

 Why Join Us?

 
 Real scale from day one. Your platform powers AI used by millions of consumers, merchants and couriers across three brands.

 Frontier work, real constraints. You'll work with the latest models and agent patterns, then make them reliable, affordable and compliant in production.

 Visible impact. Platform decisions here get reviewed by senior leadership and adopted across the company.

 
 

 We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

 🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

jobs.title: Senior Carrier and Product Management
jobs.description:
Die Position 
 Du verbindest Cyberversicherung, Produktentwicklung und Carrier-Steuerung. In dieser Schlüsselrolle verantwortest du das Versicherungsportfolio und die MGA-Partnerschaften von Eye Security und entwickelst skalierbare Lösungen für unsere europäischen Märkte
 
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Produktmanagement 
 Du entwickelst unsere Cyber-Versicherungsprodukte in Deutschland, den Niederlanden, Österreich und weiteren Ländern weiter und verknüpfst sie eng mit unserem Cyber-Guard- und Incident-Response-Angebot. Bei Bedarf koordinierst du externe Partner.

 Du verfolgst Markt-, Carrier- und Brokertrends und passt Produkte sowie Bedingungswerke gezielt an.

 Du unterstützt das Underwriting-Team und unsere Kunden bei rechtlichen und versicherungstechnischen Fragen.

 Du erkennst Compliance-Risiken in allen Märkten frühzeitig und setzt rechtskonforme Lösungen für die jeweilige Rechtsordnung um.

 Du treibst die Einführung eines modularen Produktkonzepts voran und skalierst Abläufe durch Automatisierung.

 
 Carrier Management 
 Du steuerst das Carrier Management rechtlich und strategisch. Du verhandelst und verantwortest den Abschluss von Assekuradeurverträgen in der EU und im Vereinigten Königreich und steuerst Kapazitäten für KMU und Großrisiken.

 Du baust eine stabile, langfristige und diversifizierte Carrier-Basis auf, die unserem Geschäftsmodell bestmöglich entspricht.

 Du verantwortest alle MGA-Verträge, koordinierst Verlängerungen und baust ein Claims-Management auf, das unsere Profitabilitätsziele mit den Anforderungen der Carrier verbindet.

 
 Dein Profil 
 Du verfügst über fundiertes juristisches Wissen im Bereich Cyber-Versicherung in Deutschland, den Niederlanden oder einem anderen EU-Land. Eine juristische Qualifikation als Rechtsanwalt beziehungsweise vergleichbare juristische Expertise ist ein Plus.

 Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Cyber-Produkten und Bedingungswerken aus dem Underwriting und/oder der Schadenabwicklung mit.

 Du verstehst Cyber-Compliance und regulatorische Anforderungen und hast praktische Erfahrung mit Incident-Response- und Präventionslösungen.

 Du denkst unternehmerisch, arbeitest strukturiert und detailorientiert und möchtest etwas aufbauen und skalieren.

 Du arbeitest selbstständig, trittst sicher auf und bist verlässlich. Es gelingt dir, andere mitzunehmen.

 Du verhandelst souverän mit Kunden und Partnern, bist belastbar und übernimmst Verantwortung.

 Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch sowie auf Deutsch oder Niederländisch.

 
 Das bieten wir dir 
 Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Cybersecurity-Scale-ups Europas.

 Die Möglichkeit, eine innovative Cybersecurity-Produktlinie mitzugestalten, die wirksame Cybersicherheit und Cyber-Versicherung global verbindet.

 Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive Bonus.

 Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.

 Car Allowance.

 Wahlfreiheit bei deiner Ausstattung: MacBook oder Dell Laptop sowie iPhone oder Android-Smartphone.

 Aktive Unterstützung deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung.

 Die Zusammenarbeit mit erstklassigen Cybersecurity-Expert:innen in unserem internationalen CERT-Team.

 
 Über Eye Security 
 Eye Security bietet Unternehmen in Europa Cybersicherheit mit integrierten Cyberversicherungslösungen. Unser Team vereint Fachleute mit Erfahrung in den Bereichen Nachrichtendienst, Militär, Technologie und Beratung. Sie alle verbindet eine gemeinsame Mission: Cybersicherheit auf Enterprise-Niveau für jedes Unternehmen zugänglich zu machen – nicht nur für die Großen.
 Eye Security wurde 2020 in Den Haag gegründet und vereint Managed Detection and Response, ein rund um die Uhr von Menschen betriebenes Security Operations Center (SOC), schnelle Incident Response und eine eigene Cyberversicherung auf einer einzigen Plattform. Das Unternehmen betreut Organisationen in den Niederlanden, Belgien und Deutschland und baut seine Plattform sowie den Marktzugang in ganz Europa aus.
 Eye Security wird von Bessemer Venture Partners, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners und TIN Capital unterstützt. Zuletzt nahm das Unternehmen in einer von Sofina angeführten Series-C-Finanzierungsrunde 60 Millionen Euro auf.

jobs.description:
Your Role
 As Senior Product Manager – Private Wealth (f/m/d) you build the product for LIQID's most demanding clients: entrepreneurs, families and executives whose relationship with us runs through a personal Relationship Manager. You design for two users at once – the client and the RM – and your mandate is twofold: make our Relationship Managers radically more effective, and design the end-to-end hybrid service, sales and relationship model for our most complex offerings. Our private clients hold portfolios that include private equity funds from KKR, EQT, CVC and Permira and venture stakes in companies like SpaceX, OpenAI, Stripe and Anduril. You make sure that advising on, investing in and living with these portfolios feels like the best of private banking – with the speed and clarity of a digital product.
 
 What you'll do
 End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the private client journey from introduction and first advisory meeting through onboarding, investment and long-term servicing to the next allocation. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree – net new money, share of wallet, time from advisory to investment, private markets adoption, retention, RM book capacity and cost-to-serve – and develop it further where you see sharper signals.

 RM Enablement & Advisory Tooling: Treat Relationship Managers as users, not stakeholders. You build the tools that give them more time for advice and less for administration: a client 360 view, meeting preparation and follow-up, next-best-action signals, pipeline visibility and AI copilots that draft, summarize and document – within the requirements of MiFID II on suitability, cost transparency and record-keeping.

 Hybrid Service & Sales Design: Blueprint the service model end-to-end: which moments are digital, which are personal, and which are both. Together with RM and Sales leadership you design seamless handovers, a shared view between client app and RM workspace, and service tiers that scale high-touch quality to more clients without diluting it.

 Complex Offerings, Made Simple: Make sophisticated products understandable and executable: private markets with capital calls, distributions and J-curves, and the underlying funds and companies, from Cinven and Advent to Mistral and Databricks, as well as bespoke mandates, company and holding accounts, family structures and consolidated reporting across portfolios. You work closely with the Investment team, Compliance and Operations so every journey is compliant by design.

 Discovery, Data & Experimentation: Join advisory meetings, shadow RMs and run continuous discovery with clients for whom every interaction matters. You combine qualitative depth with rigorous measurement in a small-n, high-value segment, define tracking schemas for client and RM journeys, and use AI-assisted prototyping to converge on solutions in few iteration cycles.

 Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops. You drive adoption of what you ship inside the RM organization, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for hybrid wealth management at LIQID.

 
 What you bring
 Background: 7+ years in Product Management, ideally in wealth management, private banking, FinTech or another trust-driven, advice-led domain. Experience building for internal expert users such as advisors, sales or service teams alongside end clients is a strong plus.

 Service Design & Hybrid Thinking: You think in service models, not just screens. You have designed journeys that span people, processes and software, and you know how to drive adoption and behavior change inside an organization, not only ship features to it.

 Domain Depth & Regulatory Fluency: Solid understanding of investing and wealth management (capital markets, private markets, portfolio construction), and the ambition to build regulatory fluency in a supervised environment (MiFID II, BaFin). Experience with private market products or advisory processes is a strong plus.

 Analytical & Technical Fluency: You define metrics before you build and attribute impact credibly, even with small samples. You are comfortable with CRM and workflow integrations, discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers, and using AI tooling to prototype and to build AI-assisted workflows.

 Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English , with the presence to earn credibility with experienced Relationship Managers and with clients who expect the highest standard – and to represent your roadmap toward leadership.

 Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. You want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to define what a premium hybrid private client experience looks like in an AI-native product organization.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Product Cost Optimization – Prozesse & Industrialisierung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, strengthen Europe’s innovation capacity, and play a substantial role in improving sustainability. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. The building system is based on versatile wall and slab elements, making it easier to optimize land use, customize plans, and build fast with both off-site construction and on-site assembly. This system is complemented by the Building Operating System–developed in-house.

Über die Rolle

Werde Teil von GROPYUS und gestalte aktiv die Kostenwettbewerbsfähigkeit unserer innovativen Gebäudesysteme. An der Schnittstelle von Produktentwicklung, Engineering, Fertigung, Einkauf und Bauausführung identifizierst und realisierst du Kostensenkungspotenziale über den gesamten Lebenszyklus unserer Gebäude hinweg.

Als Senior Manager Cost Optimization - Building Systems spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau transparenter Kostenstrukturen, der kritischen Bewertung technischer Lösungen sowie der Umsetzung von Value-Engineering-Initiativen über unser gesamtes Produktportfolio hinweg.

Diese Position richtet sich insbesondere an Kandidat:innen aus der Automobil-, Luftfahrt- oder Schiffbauindustrie, dem industriellen Fertigungsumfeld oder anderen Lean-geprägten Branchen. Du bringst einen nachweislichen Erfolgsausweis in den Bereichen Kostenoptimierung, Value Engineering und Operational Excellence mit und unterstützt die weitere Industrialisierung unserer Gebäudesysteme.

Dein Aufgabenbereich umfasst:

  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Kostenoptimierungsstrategie für unsere Gebäudesysteme, um Kostenwettbewerbsfähigkeit und Wertschöpfung über das gesamte Produktportfolio hinweg sicherzustellen.
  • Anwendung von Design-to-Cost-, Should-Cost-, Value-Engineering- und Target-Costing-Methoden in den Bereichen Produktentwicklung, Fertigung, Einkauf und Bauausführung.
  • Identifikation, Analyse und Priorisierung von Kostenoptimierungspotenzialen für Gebäudesysteme, Komponenten, Materialien sowie Schnittstellen in der Bauausführung.
  • Entwicklung und Pflege transparenter Kostenmodelle und Benchmarks sowie Sicherstellung eines kontinuierlichen Lernprozesses auf Basis von Soll-Ist-Kostenvergleichen.
  • Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Kostenoptimierungsinitiativen und Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus Product, Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Construction und R&D, um Kostenbewusstsein nachhaltig in Entscheidungsprozessen zu verankern.

 

Über dich

Minimale Voraussetzungen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in den Bereichen Cost Engineering, Product Costing, Value Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operational Excellence oder Kostenoptimierung innerhalb der Automobil-, Luftfahrt- oder Schiffbauindustrie, im Lean Manufacturing, in Produktionsumgebungen mit hohen Stückzahlen oder vergleichbar anspruchsvollen industriellen Umfeldern.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Lean-Manufacturing-Prinzipien und Continuous-Improvement-Methoden zur Realisierung messbarer Verbesserungen bei Kosten, Produktivität und Effizienz.
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Umsetzung messbarer Kostensenkungen und nachhaltiger Geschäftsergebnisse durch bereichsübergreifende Initiativen.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen in wirtschaftliche Auswirkungen zu übersetzen.
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Geschäftsreisen zwischen unseren Standorten.
  • Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse.

Bevorzugte Voraussetzungen

Diese Position eignet sich besonders für Kandidat:innen mit fundierter Erfahrung im Bauwesen, im Bereich vorgefertigter Bausysteme sowie in der Projektabwicklung. jobs.title: Associate Product Manager, Salesforce (6-7 months Maternity Cover)  (all genders)
Product Manager
jobs.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. 
 
The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.
 
We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.
 
We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.
 
 The Role 
 You own Banking Experience: the accounts at the center of customer's relationship with the bank, and the API and dashboards they use to manage them.
 In this role you’re responsible for redefining what beautiful software in banking looks like. You'll define account structures that give customers powerful building blocks for their products, and craft intuitive interfaces grounded in a deep understanding of their use cases and workflows.
 You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap, collaborating with design and engineering.
 
 Your First Six Months 
 Months 1-2: Take over day-to-day ownership of the Banking Experience team - the roadmap, the ways of working, the hard decisions. Establish yourself with customers and how they use our accounts. You define and ship your first project.

 Months 3-4: Execution mode. You're unblocking engineering daily, making hard prioritization calls, and shipping your roadmap to customers. You're proactively raising the bar across accounts, API, and dashboard by feeding what you learn from customers into the product.

 Months 5-6: You're working with live customers on the products you've built. Deposits and number of account holders are scaling. You've moved from execution to platform mode - evolving the roadmap based on what our customers are building on top of Augustus.

 
 Who Will Thrive At Augustus 
 We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:
 American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

 Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

 Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

 Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

 This role is for you if: 
 You want to spend time with customers to intimately understand and then innovate on their workflows.

 You’re a structured and relentless problem solver.

 You combine first-principles thinking with deep domain knowledge to make complex processes simple.

 You have taste and care deeply about the quality of what you build.

 You leverage AI to push the boundaries of what a PM can do.

 You’re excited about building a programmable bank and helping shape what that means.

 
 Hard Requirements 
 Experience end-to-end owning and building banking, fintech, or developer platform products.

 Technical enough to spar on architectural decisions with engineers - you're comfortable in API design discussions, not just UI reviews.

 You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, finance, or developer tools companies.

 You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple

 Comfortable in customer-facing roles - you've pitched, demoed, and closed early adopters yourself.

 Based in New York or Berlin, or willing to relocate.

 
 Pay transparency 
 Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location.

jobs.description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

At Staffbase, we're moving beyond communication into a new frontier: helping millions of frontline and deskless employees not just find information, but actually get things done. The Actions team owns that execution layer - the bridge between employees, Staffbase AI, and the real operational work happening in stores, warehouses, hospitals, and in the field.

Our biggest bet right now is Tasks - the product that lets an enterprise's HQ push operational standards to thousands of locations and see them executed on the ground, driven by a major new partnership. Around it sits a portfolio of agentic actions, forms, and HR workflows that make Staffbase a place where work happens, not just where it's announced.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to seize this moment. This is a 12-month fixed-term role - and we mean that as a feature. It's a rare chance to make an outsized, visible impact on Staffbase's expansion into operational territory, with senior leadership attention and real revenue behind it, without signing up for the long corporate haul. If you're a builder who loves 0-to-1 energy and wants to point it at a concrete, high-stakes problem for a year, this is for you.

You're a commercially-minded generalist, comfortable in ambiguity, fast-moving, and able to hold the whole picture - customer, business case, and build - in your head at once.

What you'll be doing

  • Own Tasks as your primary focus - shaping it from an early build into a solution that scales to thousands of frontline locations, and driving the roadmap and prioritization calls
  • Partner with an operational-retail domain expert and our internal solution designers to turn a complex real-world problem into the right solution on the Staffbase foundation
  • Work directly with flagship enterprise customers - talking eye-to-eye about their operational reality and turning it into product
  • Keep the wider Actions surface healthy - forms, HR actions, and the existing widget/plugin estate - steering maintenance priorities with the Actions Core team rather than owning the backlog yourself
  • Define what success looks like for operational products: adoption by busy frontline workers first, corporate reporting second
  • Bring an AI-native lens throughout - where an intelligent layer genuinely unblocks a worker, and where it's just noise

 Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Finance/Recht oder eine Ausbildung im Finanzbereich

 Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche und im Management von Projekten

Wir legen großen Wert auf persönliche Interaktionen und passen uns flexibel den Bedürfnissen unserer Kunden an.

jobs.title: Product Owner Finance
jobs.description:
About Weezevent
 From iconic festivals such as Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK, and Boomtown to major sporting events like the Mexico GP or the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, Weezevent supports events of all sizes and formats.
 We are the French leader in online ticketing and the European leader in cashless payments. Through all the companies forming up the Weezevent Group, we offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including access control , CRM and staff management, used across a wide variety of events all over the world.
 Founded in 2008, Weezevent received the European Fast 500 Innovation Award in 2014 and was included in the French Tech Next40 ranking in both 2024 and 2025. Today, the group employs over 180 people across France, the UK, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal and Canada, and deploys its solutions at around 1.000 major events each year.
 Weezevent is looking for a Product Owner Finance (M/F based in Clichy).
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Product Vision and Strategy : execute the overall vision and strategy for financial products (from ticketing sells to cashless payments, financial reporting, fiscal reporting, and accounting), ensuring alignment with business goals, country regulations and market demands.
 Stakeholder Collaboration : act as the primary liaison between stakeholders (finance, compliance, sales, marketing) and the development team to gather requirements and prioritize features. 
Detect and report payments incidents when impacting organizers appreciation.
Communicate the product vision and strategy effectively to stakeholders and team members.
Provide operational support to the Client success and Finance teams. Providing help for PSP configurations, responding to questions in Slack, triaging RUN requests and generating custom exports is key for the well functioning of the company.
 Product Backlog Management : create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer feedback, market trends, and regulatory requirements.
Write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team.
 Development and Delivery : work closely with the development team during sprints to ensure the product is being built according to specifications and timelines. 
Review, QA and accept completed user stories to ensure they meet the acceptance criteria and deliver the expected value.
 Market and User Research : analyze user data and metrics to inform product decisions and identify areas for improvement, particularly in payments technology.
 Compliance and Risk Management : ensure that financial products comply with relevant country/tax/fiscal regulations, standards, and best practices, including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and other industry-specific requirements.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with financial products and solutions with a strong emphasis on compliance and regulatory adherence.
 Performance Monitoring : monitor product performance and customer satisfaction, using data and analytics to track key performance indicators. 
Implement changes and improvements based on performance metrics and user feedback.
 
 Why it's a good move ? 
You will be responsible for executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for finance functionalities, infrastructure and operational capabilities related to all our products. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders, to ensure the successful delivery of financial products that meet market needs and regulatory requirements, with a strong focus on compliance.
 
 Fundamentals to join us :
 You have a Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner) ; 

 You have +5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Consultant, or similar role, in a start-up, company or function where payment is core. Having a strong understanding of payments & financial concepts, markets, and instruments is mandatory.

 You have a proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.

 You speak French fluently.

 Just like you, we prefer to work with energetic, friendly and highly committed person. Take on new challenges in a creative sector, send us your CV and let's talk !
 All of our positions are open to people with disabilities. 
 Compensation and benefits
 We offer a salary of EUR 50,400–65,000 per year for this permanent contract based in Clichy with a hybrid working arrangement. Private health insurance is provided to cover your medical needs. Public transportation benefits support your daily commute. Paid sick leave ensures you have time to recover when needed. Home Office options offer flexibility in your weekly schedule. A casual dress code allows you to wear what makes you comfortable at work. Regular team events and social activities keep you connected with colleagues.

jobs.title: Founding lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions. 

 We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates. 

 We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies.

 Tasks

 User Research & Discovery 

 
 Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks.

 Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in.

 Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people.

 Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision.

 
  

 Product & Experience Design 

 
 What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it.

 Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves.

 Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have.

 Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products.

 Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot.

 Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them.

 
 Requirements

 
 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products.

 A strong portfolio that shows both craft and thinking: we want to see how you operated, not just what shipped.

 A skilled researcher who can design a study, run it in the wild, and turn qualitative chaos into clear direction.

 Experience designing inside environments you don't control - a messaging client, an extension, an embedded product - or a clear appetite for it.

 Comfortable designing for AI-driven and adaptive experiences, where the interface has to handle uncertainty, personalization, and non-linear workflows.

 Excellent visual and interaction design skills: typography, spacing, motion, and the small details that build trust.

 Autonomous and opinionated, but you hold your opinions loosely when the evidence says otherwise.

 Genuine curiosity about AI and how people actually learn at work.

 Fluent in French and English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

 You want the ownership, equity, and career-defining challenge that only comes from being early.

 Bonus: deeply passionate about something outside of work.

 
 Benefits

 
 A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy.

 Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Paris startup ecosystem.

 Flexibility: remote-friendly with regular in-person collaboration in Paris and an office in Montmartre with a beautiful Sacré-Coeur view.

 A front-row seat to one of the most important shifts in how humans learn.

 A small, sharp team that ships fast and trusts each other to figure things out.

 If you care deeply about making powerful tools feel human and want to shape a product from the very beginning, this is your role. Apply now and help us build the future of learning.

 Raison is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team.
